confirmed.title: stage 暫停（視窗隱藏／CPP suspend／角色 hide）後 Roll Call 仍回報凍結前的殘影活動
confirmed.claim: `StageRenderer.rollCallNow()` 只把 `frozen` 與 `reducedMotion` 當成「世界沒有在動」的訊號，完全不看 `this.paused`。但 `pause()`（document.hidden → gateway.suspend、CPP suspend、`hide()`）會取消 rAF 讓 `stepWorld` 停止步進、世界原地保留，於是 `char.mode`／`familiar.state` 變成殘影，Roll Call 仍會對 Runtime 回報「在追玩具」「在散步」，控制中心的「現在大家在做什麼」照樣照抄。這正是 companion-gameplay-033 已經為 frozen／Reduced Motion 修掉的同一類誠實缺口，只是換成 paused 路徑。
confirmed.evidence: stage.ts:658-663 `rollCallNow(machineLabel) { return rollCall(this.world, this.charName, machineLabel, this.now(), { frozen: this.flags.frozen, reducedMotion: this.timeline.isReducedMotion() }); }`——沒有第三個 `paused` 條件。playfield.ts:821 `const still = opts.frozen === true || opts.reducedMotion === true;` 是 rollCall 唯一的「世界靜止」判準。stage.ts:454-459 `pause()` 只 `cancelAnimationFrame`，doc comment 明寫「狀態（世界、玩具、表情）原地保留」，因此 `char.mode` 停在 chase/stroll/… 不變。觸發路徑：CompanionApp.tsx:1253-1265 `onVisibility` 先 `beat()`（beat 內 1234-1236 `shuRef.current.rollCallNow(machineLabel)` 並隨 presentationHello 送出）再 `gateway.suspend(PRIMARY_INSTANCE_ID)`；shu.ts:268-271 `suspend() { this.suspended = true; this.stage?.pause(); }`、shu.ts:263-266 `hide()` 同樣 `this.stage?.pause()`。消費端 pages/CompanionPage.tsx:731-745 直接列出 `state.rollCall` 的 activity 字串，而該區塊的說明文字是「角色隱藏、離線或剛啟動時不會用預設值冒充」。

verdicts.reasoning:
Traced the full mechanism end-to-end and it holds up.

1. `StageRenderer.pause()` (stage.ts:454-459) is a purely renderer-internal concept: it cancels rAF and its own doc comment says state (world/toys/expression) is left in place ("狀態（世界、玩具、表情）原地保留"). `loop()` (stage.ts:858) is gated by `if (this.destroyed || this.paused) return;`, and `stepWorld` (which advances `world.char.mode` / `familiar.state`) is only invoked from inside `renderFrame`, itself only called from `loop`. So once paused, nothing else steps the world — confirmed no secondary timer drives `stepWorld`.

2. `pause()`/`resume()` are wired to window-hidden / CPP-suspend / hide, NOT to the machine truthState's own "paused" base value. Trigger chain confirmed: `ShuCharacterAdapter.suspend()` and `.hide()` (character/adapters/shu.ts) both call `this.stage?.pause()`; `CharacterGateway.suspend()` (character/gateway.ts:518-519) calls the adapter's `.suspend()`; `CompanionApp.tsx`'s `onVisibility` handler calls `gateway.suspend(PRIMARY_INSTANCE_ID)` when `document.hidden` is true.

3. `rollCallNow()` (stage.ts:658-663) passes only `this.flags.frozen` and `this.timeline.isReducedMotion()` into `rollCall()` — no reference to `this.paused` anywhere. `flags.frozen` is computed by `machineStageFlags()` (stage.ts:333) purely from the CPP machine's `base` truthState string being one of "emergency"/"offline"/"paused" (a completely different "paused" — the safety-governor's own state value, unrelated to window visibility) and is only ever pushed via `setMachineFlags` from CPP intents (CompanionApp.tsx:550, shu.ts:153) — never from `document.hidden`.

4. `rollCall()` in companion/playfield.ts:813-821 derives `still = frozen || reducedMotion` and, when `still` is false, reads live off `world.char.mode` / `f.state` — which is exactly the frozen-in-time snapshot from before `pause()`. This is verified for familiars unconditionally, and for the character row whenever `machineLabel` is null (i.e., base truthState isn't emergency/offline/paused/quiet and no active transient — a perfectly normal idle/working state while the window happens to be hidden).

5. Confirmed the stale data actually reaches a consumer: `CompanionApp.tsx`'s `beat()` (10s `setInterval`, never cleared on hide) calls `shuRef.current.rollCallNow(machineLabel)` and ships it via `api.presentationHello(...)` regardless of `document.hidden`. On the Rust side (`crates/interaction-runtime/src/presentation.rs` `snapshot()`), `behaviorState` is returned whenever `connected` (heartbeat freshness, 20s TTL) is true — independent of `visible`. `CompanionPage.tsx`'s `RollCall` component (line ~729-745) reads `presence.behaviorState.rollCall` directly with no gate on `presence.visible`, and the page polls `presentation_status()` every 5s — comfortably inside the 20s staleness window — so it will display the stale, pre-pause activity strings as if live.

6. Confirmed by omission: existing tests (`regressions-run2-companion.test.ts`, `regressions-review2-companion.test.ts`) cover the `frozen` (emergency/offline/paused-truthState) and `reducedMotion` honesty fix for Roll Call, but none exercise `stage.pause()`/`gateway.suspend`/`hide` in combination with `rollCallNow`, matching the claim that this is the same honesty gap re-opened through an uncovered path.

All cited file:line evidence (stage.ts:658-663, stage.ts:454-459, playfield.ts:821, shu.ts suspend/hide, CompanionApp.tsx onVisibility/beat, CompanionPage.tsx RollCall) matches current file contents almost exactly (only a few lines of citation drift in CompanionApp.tsx/shu.ts, immaterial). This is a real, reproducible honesty-ladder gap: while the character stage is paused for window-hidden/CPP-suspend/hide reasons (not machine-truthState "paused"), Roll Call can report residual pre-freeze activity ("在追玩具"/"在散步") as if current, contradicting the project's "感測不靜默"/"誠實階梯" invariant and the page's own promise not to fake activity while hidden.

confirmed.fix: `rollCallNow()` 把 `this.paused` 一併併入 rollCall 的 `still` 條件（或新增 `paused` opt），暫停時對角色與使魔一律回「停下來了／在睡覺」；CompanionApp 的 `beat()` 也應在 `document.hidden` 時以暫停後的狀態計算，而不是在 suspend 之前先取一份。
confirmed.regressionTest: In a Vitest test, build a stage via the Shu adapter/gateway, get the character into a non-"free" `world.char.mode` (e.g. spawn a toy + advance frames until `char.mode === "chase"`), set machine base to a normal state (not emergency/offline/paused/quiet) so `flags.frozen` stays false, then call `gw.suspend("a")` (mirroring window-hidden) and assert `a.rollCallNow(null)` no longer reports "在追玩具"/etc. but something honest like "停下來了" — it will currently still report the stale live-looking activity.

confirmed.title: Reduced Motion 下光點／逗貓棒仍每幀跟著游標平滑移動，與模組契約及 manifest 宣告的 `gameplay.toys: disabled` 互相矛盾
confirmed.claim: `stepWorld()` 的游標玩具分支（light／wand）寫在 Reduced Motion 短路**之前**並且 `continue`，所以 Reduced Motion 開啟時光點與逗貓棒照樣以 `dt*14` 的指數插值追游標、逗貓棒在游標離場時還會平滑垂下。這與 playfield.ts 檔頭「reduced motion：無自主移動與物理彈跳」、stage.ts 檔頭「Reduced Motion：無自主移動、無物理彈跳、無粒子」，以及 shu manifest 對 `gameplay.toys` 宣告的 `reducedMotionBehavior: "disabled"`（CPP §3.3 語意＝該能力在 Reduced Motion 下不可用、必須往下一個 fallback）全部衝突；StageRenderer 的 spawn／grab／drag 路徑也完全沒有 Reduced Motion 守衛。
confirmed.evidence: playfield.ts:298-313：`if (toy.kind === "light" || toy.kind === "wand") { if (inputs.pointer && inputs.cursorPlayEnabled) { toy.x += (target.x - toy.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 14); toy.y += (target.y - toy.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 14); … } else { … if (toy.kind === "wand") toy.y += (w.ground - 24 - toy.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 6); } toys.push(toy); continue; }`，緊接著第 314 行才是 `if (inputs.reducedMotion) { toy.y = w.ground - 6; toy.vx = 0; toy.vy = 0; … continue; }`——順序決定 cursor toy 永遠拿不到 Reduced Motion 短路。playfield.ts:8-9 檔頭：「frozen（緊急/離線/暫停）：一切凍結；reduced motion：無自主移動與物理彈跳（玩具仍可拖放，直接落地）」。stage.ts:636-643 `spawnToy(kind)` 只檢查 `this.flags.frozen`；stage.ts:754-758 `pointerDown` 的 `grabToyAt` 也只擋 frozen。character/manifest.ts:964 `"gameplay.toys": supported({ reducedMotionBehavior: "disabled" })`；docs/character-protocol/README.md:152 「`reducedMotion=true` 時，若所用能力 `reducedMotionBehavior ∈ {static, reduced}` → `reduced`；`disabled` → 繼續往下一個 fallback」。另：stage.ts:779-783 `pointerMove` 每次都 `invalidateStatic()`，所以這段移動在 Reduced Motion 下確實會被畫出來（靜態短路被打掉）。

verdicts.reasoning:
親自讀 apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/playfield.ts 確認第 296-316 行結構與 finding 引述完全一致：`if (toy.kind === "light" || toy.kind === "wand") { if (inputs.pointer && inputs.cursorPlayEnabled) { toy.x += (target.x - toy.x) * Math.min(1, dt*14); ... } else { ...if (wand) toy.y += (ground-24-toy.y)*min(1,dt*6); } toys.push(toy); continue; }` 緊接著才是第 314 行 `if (inputs.reducedMotion) {...}`——順序使 cursor toy 分支永遠先 continue，reducedMotion 短路對 light/wand 完全無效。

追查 cursorPlayEnabled 的唯一來源：stage.ts:930 `cursorPlayEnabled: this.toggles.cursorPlay`，toggles 預設 `{cursorPlay: true}`（stage.ts:357），`setReducedMotion()`（stage.ts:425-428）只呼叫 `this.timeline.setReducedMotion(on)` 與 `invalidateStatic()`，完全不動 `toggles.cursorPlay`——證實 reducedMotion 開啟時 cursorPlayEnabled 仍為 true，不會間接擋掉這條分支。

用最小重現測試直接呼叫 stepWorld 驗證：spawn 一個 light 玩具、`reducedMotion:true`、`pointer` 設在遠處、跑一步 stepWorld（dt=16ms）。結果：toy 位置從 (100,124) 平滑移動到 (122.4,135.2)——與宣稱的 dt*14 指數插值完全吻合，證實這是真實可重現的行為，非誤讀。跑完後已刪除暫存測試檔（未留下改動）。

可達性確認：SHU_TOYS catalog（shuTables.ts:149-155）含 light（✨光點）與 wand（🪶逗貓棒），CompanionApp.tsx:2079-2086 的玩具選單只擋 `!frozen`（不擋 reducedMotion），quickToy()（CompanionApp.tsx:1939-1951）呼叫 stage.spawnToy() 而 spawnToy()（stage.ts:636-642）、pointerDown/grabToyAt（stage.ts:754-758）也只擋 frozen，不擋 reducedMotion——與 finding 的「StageRenderer 的 spawn／grab／drag 路徑也沒有 Reduced Motion 守衛」相符。

進一步確認畫面確實會被畫出來、不是被靜態短路吃掉：pointerMove()（stage.ts:779-783）每次都無條件呼叫 invalidateStatic()（把 staticDrawn 設 false），而主迴圈（stage.ts:868-878）在 reducedMotion 下的短路條件是 `if (staticDrawn && now-lastReducedDrawAt < REDUCED_TICK_MS) return`——staticDrawn 一旦被 pointerMove 打成 false，下一個 rAF 立刻又呼叫 renderFrame()。所以只要滑鼠在遊玩場內移動，reducedMotion 的靜態短路形同虛設，light/wand 動畫會逐幀被畫出來。

對比 dragToy()（playfield.ts:229-238）：抓著拖曳時是直接把座標設成 (x,y)（無 easing），符合檔頭「玩具仍可拖放，直接落地」的唯一例外；而 light/wand 的游標跟隨是不需要抓取、純靠 pointer 存在就啟動的**指數平滑動畫**，不在該例外範圍內，也未被任何 reducedMotion 檢查覆蓋。

檢查既有測試（playfield.test.ts:97-104）：唯一的 Reduced Motion 測試只測 "yarn"（一般物理玩具），pointer 預設 null，完全沒測到 light/wand + reducedMotion + 有 pointer 的組合，證實這條路徑目前無測試覆蓋，不是「已被測試覆蓋的防護」。

檢查 CHANGELOG.md／docs/acceptance-evidence.md，未見任何「toy cursor-follow 在 reduced motion 下的已知限制」記錄，非已知並接受的差距。

唯一稍嫌牽強之處：finding 把 character/manifest.ts:964 `"gameplay.toys": supported({reducedMotionBehavior:"disabled"})` 直接類比成「這個互動玩具小遊戲系統」的契約——但追查 protocol.ts:444 與 shu.ts:perform() 可知 gameplay.toys 這個 CPP capability 實際上是用來承載 Runtime 送來的抽象 Character Intent「play」（透過 shuExpressionPlan 產生一個表情/姿勢演出），走的是完全不同的一條程式路徑（intent 協商→mixer.apply），跟本地滑鼠拖放/游標跟隨的 playfield 小遊戲是兩個獨立子系統。所以「與 manifest 宣告直接矛盾」這句在技術上略為以偏概全，manifest 的 disabled 語意嚴格來說管的是 intent 協商 fallback，不是這個本地互動迴圈。但這不影響 finding 的核心、可獨立成立的缺陷：playfield.ts／stage.ts 自己的檔頭註解明白宣告「Reduced Motion：無自主移動、無物理彈跳」，而程式碼結構（cursor toy 分支寫在 reducedMotion 短路之前並 continue）確實讓 light/wand 違反這條自身契約，且經最小腳本重現驗證為真、可達、無測試覆蓋、未被記錄為已知限制。核心技術主張（順序缺陷＋行為矛盾＋可重現）完全站得住腳，manifest 引用只是佐證論述稍嫌鬆散，不足以推翻整個 finding。

confirmed.fix: 把 `if (inputs.reducedMotion)` 短路移到 cursor toy 分支之前（Reduced Motion 時光點／逗貓棒直接貼在游標位置、不做插值，或整個不生成）；並在 `StageRenderer.spawnToy()`／`grabToyAt` 路徑加上 Reduced Motion 守衛，或把 manifest 的 `gameplay.toys` 改成誠實的 `reduced` 而非 `disabled`。
confirmed.regressionTest: stepWorld(world-with-one-"light"-toy, {reducedMotion:true, pointer:{x:toy.x+100,y:toy.y+50}, cursorPlayEnabled:true}, rng) 跑一步後 expect(after.toys[0].x).toBe(toy.x)（即應維持原地／落地，而非朝 pointer 平滑位移）——目前會失敗，因為實測結果是 x 從 100 位移到 122.4。

confirmed.title: lie↔直立姿勢過場中頭／貓耳／頭飾與身體脫節最多 6.24px、持續 234–284ms（poseBlend 只修了頭部高度，沒修水平錨點）
confirmed.claim: `layoutFor()` 在姿勢過場時線性插值 `hx`（lie 的 52 ↔ 直立的 64），而 `drawHead`／`drawEars`／`drawHeadpiece` 是唯三讀 `L.hx` 的函式；`drawUprightBody` 全部硬寫 x=64、`drawLieBody` 全部硬寫 lie 專用座標（58/98/104/40/46/52…），兩者都不讀 `L.hx`。結果是：任何 lie↔直立（stand/crouch/sit）過場期間，頭部連同貓耳與頭飾會相對軀幹橫向漂移最多 6.24px，並且持續約 234–284ms（不是單幀），使頭與身體在整段過場中明顯錯位。既有回歸測試只量 `layoutFor(...).hy`（頭中心高度），完全看不到這條水平軸。
confirmed.evidence:
draw.ts:48 `hx: 52`（lieLayout）／:67 `hx: 64`（uprightLayout）／:83 `hx: m(from.hx, to.hx)`（mixLayout）。讀 L.hx 者只有 draw.ts:771 `ctx.translate(L.hx, L.hy)`（drawHead）、:912 `const bx = L.hx + side * 12 * earS + turn * 0.5`（drawEars）、:954 `ctx.translate(L.hx, L.hy - L.hry + 2)`（drawHeadpiece）。drawUprightBody（draw.ts:206-315）與 drawLieBody（:641-676）完全不出現 L.hx。

實測（esbuild 打包後以 node 跑真 ExpressionTimeline，rng=()=>0.5、16.7ms 取樣、PAL=maid-classic，anchor = L.lie ? 52 : 64）：全部 64×63=4032 組表情切換中，243 組的頭-軀幹水平偏移 >3px，最差 10 名：
  6.24px @ +267ms（234ms >0.5px）lie-flat → success-verified（pose=lie from=crouch blend=0.480 hx=58.24）
  6.24px @ +267ms sleep → success-verified
  6.21px @ +267ms lie-flat → pounce-miss
  6.00px @ +267ms lie-flat → land-light
  5.97px @ +351ms（251ms）poked → sleep（pose=lie from=stand blend=0.503 hx=57.97）
  5.96px @ +451ms（284ms）emergency → lie-flat
對照：同一批掃描的頭部高度單幀跳變最大只有 4.48px（lie-flat→startled-awake），全數低於專案自訂的 12px 門檻——高度軸已修好，水平軸沒修。

既有測試只覆蓋 hy：regressions-phase7.test.ts:899-914、regressions-run2-companion.test.ts:661-685、regressions-review2-companion.test.ts:126-130、:212 全部是 `layoutFor(...).hy`。

verdicts.reasoning:
Direct code reading confirms every citation exactly, no line drift: draw.ts:48 lieLayout hx=52, :67 uprightLayout hx=64, :83 mixLayout linearly interpolates hx via m(from.hx,to.hx). The only readers of L.hx are drawHead (:771 ctx.translate(L.hx,L.hy)), drawEars (:912 bx = L.hx + side*12*earS + turn*0.5) and drawHeadpiece (:954 ctx.translate(L.hx, L.hy-L.hry+2)) — confirmed via grep across the whole file. drawUprightBody (:206-315) draws every torso/leg/skirt/arm/collar element at the literal constant 64, never reading L.hx. drawLieBody (:641-676) draws boots/skirt/apron/paws/sleeve/core at literal constants (98,104,58,66,92,100,60,68,84,90,40,46,52,58), also never reading L.hx. Which body function runs is chosen by L.lie (draw.ts:160), and mixLayout sets `lie: to.lie` (target pose only, not blended) — so during any lie<->upright pose transition the body is drawn at its fixed canonical anchor (64 upright / the lie-specific literals) while the head/ears/headpiece are drawn at the blended, moving L.hx, producing a real geometric mismatch, not just a style nit.

I reproduced the exact numbers analytically instead of just trusting the report: offset(blend) = |m(from.hx,to.hx,blend) - target_canonical_hx|. For a target of lie (canonical hx=52) coming from any upright pose (hx=64, since stand/crouch/sit all share uprightLayout's hx=64): offset = (64-52)*(1-blend) = 12*(1-blend). Checked against two of the report's data points: blend=0.480 -> 12*0.52=6.24, matching the reported 'lie-flat<-crouch blend=0.480 hx=58.24' (58.24 = m(64,52,0.48), offset vs 52 = 6.24) exactly; blend=0.503 -> 12*0.497=5.964≈5.97 matching 'stand->lie blend=0.503 hx=57.97' exactly. The theoretical max as blend->0 is 12px, so a scan-observed 6.24px peak (constrained by how blend actually evolves across the 260ms POSE_TRANSITION_MS, defined at timeline.ts:38, over a discrete 16.7ms sample grid) is entirely consistent with the mechanism, not fabricated. The 234-284ms persistence window is likewise consistent with a ~260ms linear pose-blend transition staying above a small px threshold for most but not all of its length.

I also confirmed the claim that existing regression tests only cover the vertical axis: grep across the three files that call layoutFor (regressions-phase7.test.ts, regressions-review2-companion.test.ts, regressions-run2-companion.test.ts) shows every call site reads `.hy` only; `.hx` never appears in any test file. So this defect has zero test coverage, exactly as claimed.

This is a real, currently-present rendering defect: during any lie<->upright pose transition (stand/crouch/sit <-> lie), the head/cat-ears/headpiece visibly detach horizontally from the torso for a few hundred ms, and no test guards it. Severity 'medium' is reasonable — it's a cosmetic animation-only defect with no safety/data/honesty-ladder implication, self-corrects by the end of the transition, but is genuinely visible (multi-px, multi-frame, not a single-frame pop) on the character's primary transition path.

confirmed.fix: 讓 drawUprightBody／drawLieBody 以 `L.hx` 為身體中心（把硬寫的 64 改成 L.hx、lie 的固定座標改成 L.hx + 相對位移），或反過來在過場時不插值 hx、改以整個角色的 ctx.translate 位移；再補一條回歸測試量「頭中心 x − 軀幹錨點 x」的最大值。
confirmed.regressionTest: During a lie<->upright pose transition (e.g. layoutFor with pose='lie', poseFrom='crouch', poseBlend=0.48), assert that the head anchor L.hx used for drawHead/drawEars/drawHeadpiece stays within a small epsilon of the fixed torso anchor the active body-drawing function actually uses for that L.lie target (64 for upright, the lie-body's own canonical x for lie) — i.e. add a test reading layoutFor(...).hx across the poseBlend sweep, not just .hy, and fail if the horizontal offset from the target pose's canonical anchor exceeds e.g. 1-2px.

confirmed.title: OFFICIAL_36 中 startled-awake（被吵醒）與 not-found（找不到）沒有任何觸發路徑，卻在出貨 manifest 宣告為支援的表情
confirmed.file: apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/rig/expressions.ts:1505（OFFICIAL_36 起於 1495；not-found 在 1527）；CHANGELOG.md 已知限制段落實際在 663-665（finding 寫 622-623，屬行號漂移，引文內容無誤）
confirmed.claim: spec §7.1「驚醒」與 §7.5 首批 36 表情的「被吵醒」「找不到」在 expressions.ts 有完整關鍵幀定義、列進 `OFFICIAL_36`、也被三份出貨 manifest 宣告成 `visual.expression.variants` 與 `states`，但整個 repo 沒有任何程式路徑會播它們：machine.ts 的 pose() 不產生這兩個動畫名，shuTables 的 ambient／reaction／landing／wait／notice／play／sleep 變體表與 shuExpressionPlan 都沒有映射，playfield 的 expression 事件也沒有。它們只出現在表情定義、OFFICIAL_36 清單（給預覽格用）與註解裡。也就是 36 個正式表情中有 2 個只做到「預覽格裡的圖」，而 manifest 對外宣告的能力面比實際能演的多。
confirmed.evidence:
repo-wide grep（排除 node_modules 與 src/test）：`startled-awake` 只命中 expressions.ts:191（定義）、expressions.ts:1505（OFFICIAL_36）、draw.ts:104 與 params.ts:418 的註解，以及 public/characters/shu-maid{,-dusk,-sakura}/manifest.json:49（visual.expression.variants）與 :244（states）。`"not-found"` 只命中 expressions.ts:1113（定義）、expressions.ts:1527（OFFICIAL_36）與 work/delivery.ts:102/128/150（那是投遞結果字串，映射到 "send-failed"，不進角色層）。

shuTables.ts 的全部注入表都沒有這兩個 id：SHU_AMBIENT_VARIANTS（:40-51）、SHU_REACTIONS（:62-77）、SHU_LANDING（:107-111）、PLAY_VARIANTS（:178-189）、NOTICE_VARIANTS（:191-202）、WAIT_VARIANTS（:204-209）、SLEEP_VARIANTS（:211-215）、SHU_EVENT_ART（:127-135）、shuExpressionPlan（:230-283）。machine.ts pose()（:340-393）產生的動畫名為 emergency/offline/listening/thinking/routing/ask/act/waiting/success/blocked/unknown/failed/clicked/dragged/idle/quiet/paused。

manifest 確認：`python3 -c "json.load(open('public/characters/shu-maid/manifest.json'))"` → visual.expression.variants 共 64 項且 `'startled-awake' in v == True`、`'not-found' in v == True`；states 同樣 64 項且都包含。

CHANGELOG.md:622-623 的已知限制只揭露「四段全手寫只有 4/36」與頭飾／口袋／袖口未實作，沒有揭露這兩個表情不可達。

verdicts.reasoning:
親自重現，全部可查證主張都成立，找不到反駁角度。

1) 定義與清單核對無誤：expressions.ts:191 `E("startled-awake", "被吵醒", ...)`、:1113 `E("not-found", "找不到", ...)`；OFFICIAL_36 陣列中 startled-awake 在第 1505 行、not-found 在第 1527 行（逐行點算與陣列字面順序完全吻合，行號未漂移）。

2) manifest 核對無誤：`python3 -c "json.load(...)"` 對 shu-maid/manifest.json 得 `capabilities['visual.expression']['variants']` 64 項、`states` 64 項，兩者都含 `startled-awake` 與 `not-found`（True/True）。三份 manifest（shu-maid／-dusk／-sakura）grep 命中位置一致。

3) 逐一排查所有可能的觸發入口，全部確認不含這兩個 id：
   - `shuExpressionPlan()`（shuTables.ts:229-284）是唯一把 IntentEnvelope（CPP 外部/AI 可達路徑）轉成動畫名的函式，switch 窮舉 20 個 canonical CharacterIntent，變體表 PLAY_VARIANTS/NOTICE_VARIANTS/WAIT_VARIANTS/SLEEP_VARIANTS 全部列舉過，無一項映到這兩個 id。
   - `machine.ts` `pose()`（348-393）只吐 canonical 動畫名；`clicked`/`dragged`/`performing` 三種 kind 會把 `t.animation` 原樣播出，但 `t.animation` 唯一來源正是上面 `shuExpressionPlan()` 與舊路徑 `presentationCommands.ts` 的 `INTENT_TO_TRANSIENT`/`PLAYABLE_ART`（兩個都是封閉表，同樣不含這兩個 id）。
   - Director 表（SHU_AMBIENT_VARIANTS、SHU_REACTIONS、SHU_LANDING、SHU_EVENT_ART）、`EXPRESSION_ALIASES`：grep 全部零命中，且無隨機 fallback 會從 OFFICIAL_36 亂選。
   - 特別驗證了語意上最自然的候選觸發點——director.ts:290-296 睡眠 ambient 被打斷（「被戳醒」）的恢復邏輯——結果程式碼刻意放棄恢復計畫、注解明寫「剛被戳醒…回 idle 系」，並未觸發 startled-awake，證明這不是漏接而是設計上真的沒有任何路徑通往它。
   - `previewExpressions()`/`drawPreviewExpression()`（shu.ts:68,89）唯一呼叫點在 `CharacterPreview.tsx` 的 `RigPreviewCell`，只是把表情畫進一個獨立 `<canvas>` 供設定頁預覽格用，沒有點擊事件、沒有派送到真正的 mixer／舞台。
   - playfield.ts／gameFeel.ts／gatewayWiring.ts 全零命中。
   - 全 repo grep（.ts/.tsx/.json/.rs，排除 node_modules 與 /src/test/）除定義、OFFICIAL_36、三份 manifest、兩處註解（draw.ts:104、params.ts:418）外無其他命中；"not-found" 額外命中 work/delivery.ts 是完全無關的投遞結果字串（映射到 "send-failed"，不進角色層），與 finding 陳述一致。

4) 揭露落差核對：CHANGELOG.md 現版「已知限制」段落內容與 finding 引用文字完全一致（「四段全手寫只有 4/36」、頭飾／口袋／袖口未實作），但實際行號現為 663-665（非 finding 寫的 622-623——文件在此之後有增補，行號漂移，內容本身無誤）；`docs/acceptance-evidence.md`、`docs/releases/v0.5.0-known-limitations.md`、`v0.5.1-known-limitations.md` 都 grep 不到 startled-awake／not-found／「不可達」等字樣，確認這個能力落差確實未被揭露。

結論：36 個正式表情中有 2 個（startled-awake、not-found）在出貨 manifest 對外宣告為 `visual.expression.variants` 與 `states`，但整個 repo 找不到任何會播放它們的程式路徑，只有預覽格能畫出靜態單幀；也未列入任何已知限制文件。這是真實、可重現的「宣告能力 > 實際能力」缺口，medium 嚴重度合理（manifest 對外能力聲明不實，但不涉及安全/estop/truthState 等更高風險不變量）。

confirmed.fix: 二選一：(a) 接上真實觸發——sleepy ambient（doze/lie-flat/sleep）被互動打斷時改播 startled-awake；work/delivery 的 not-found 結果經 machine 映到 not-found 表情；(b) 若不接，就從 manifest 的 variants/states 移除，並在 CHANGELOG／docs/acceptance-evidence.md 的已知限制列明「36 表情中 2 個目前只有預覽、無觸發來源」。
confirmed.regressionTest: 寫一個測試遍歷所有可達觸發面（20 個 CharacterIntent × 各 variant 表、SHU_REACTIONS、SHU_AMBIENT_VARIANTS、SHU_LANDING、SHU_EVENT_ART、EXPRESSION_ALIASES）收集出實際可播出的 expression id 集合，斷言它是 OFFICIAL_36 的超集；目前 startled-awake 與 not-found 會使斷言失敗。

confirmed.title: 點擊／拖曳先呼叫 reactDetailed() 才 apply()，把 Director 的「中斷後恢復」計畫在建立前就抹掉——§6.1「動作可中斷、可恢復」在最常見的兩條中斷路徑上永遠不成立
confirmed.claim: InteractionDirector 的 interrupted/resume 機制（director.ts:198-212 notePreempted、:289-306 tick 的恢復分支）本身可用，但在生產路徑上永遠不會被觸發：CompanionApp 在 apply() 之前就先呼叫 director.reactDetailed()，而 reactDetailed 第 277 行 `this.interrupted = null` 會清掉恢復計畫、並把 currentAction 換成剛建立的短反應。等到 apply() 內的 wasPreempted → notePreempted(now) 執行時，Director 手上的 currentAction 已經是那個 700ms／2200ms／1500ms 的反應（都 < notePreempted 要求的 durationMs>=4000），因此既不恢復舊動作，也不會排任何新的恢復計畫。結果：被玩家戳一下或抱起來而中斷的長 ambient（tailhug 7s／legswing 6s／spaced-out 5s／lie-flat 9s／doze 10s）永遠回不去，spec §6.1「動作可中斷、可恢復、可取消」與 docs/v05-capability-gap-matrix.md:114「Interaction Director→已有」在這條路徑上不成立。
confirmed.evidence:
呼叫順序（未修改任何檔案，逐行確認）：
- CompanionApp.tsx:1818-1824 `const plan = planClickReaction({ ..., director: directorRef.current, rng: microRng.current })` — gameFeel.ts:238／251 在其中呼叫 `input.director.reactDetailed("poked-rapid"|"poked", ...)`；
- CompanionApp.tsx:1829-1830（連戳）／1833（單擊）才 `apply({type:"transient", kind:"clicked"|"performing", ...})`，apply 內（CompanionApp.tsx:526-528）才 `wasPreempted(...) → directorRef.current.notePreempted(now)`；
- 拖曳同樣順序：CompanionApp.tsx:573 `reactDetailed("lifted", now, DRAG_HOLD_MS, ...)` → :575 `apply({type:"transient", kind:"dragged", ...})`；
- director.ts:277 `this.interrupted = null; // 新反應取消舊的恢復計畫`＋:276 `this.currentAction = { action, startedAt: nowMs }`；director.ts:204 `if (remaining > 1_500 && action.durationMs >= 4_000)`。

以 scratchpad vitest（不動 repo；config root 指向 apps/interaction-desktop，直接 import 真實 director.ts／shuTables.ts／gameFeel.ts）重現，3/3 通過：
1) 基準：排出 `{expression:'tailhug', durationMs:7000, source:'ambient'}` 後只呼叫 `notePreempted(t)` → 下一 tick 回 `{expression:'tailhug', durationMs:6000, source:'resume'}`（機制本身可用）。
2) 生產順序：`planClickReaction({rapid:false, nowMs:t, director:d, rng:()=>0.5})`（回 `{kind:'single', animation:'poked-flinch', durationMs:700}`）之後才 `notePreempted(t)` → 之後 60 個 tick（30 秒，rng 固定 0.999 讓 hazard 不出手，只有 resume 能出現）產出 `[]`，0 個 source:'resume'。
3) 拖曳同樣：`reactDetailed('lifted', t, 1500, ...)` 後 `notePreempted(t)` → 60 tick 產出 `[]`。

對照：既有測試 src/test/rig.test.ts:271「長動作被搶佔後可恢復」只直接呼叫 notePreempted，沒有測 App 的「先 react 後 preempt」順序，所以這個缺口沒有回歸覆蓋。

verdicts.reasoning:
Verified by direct code reading plus an independent vitest repro (written to a scratchpad test file, run, then deleted — repo left clean).

Production call order, confirmed by line inspection:
- CompanionApp.tsx onPointerUp (click path): `const plan = planClickReaction({ ..., director: directorRef.current, rng: microRng.current })` is called, then only afterward `apply({ type: "transient", kind: "clicked"|"performing", ... })`. gameFeel.ts's `planClickReaction` (lines 238 and 251) calls `input.director.reactDetailed("poked-rapid"|"poked", ...)` synchronously before returning.
- CompanionApp.tsx beginDragHold (drag path, lines 573-575): `directorRef.current.reactDetailed("lifted", now, DRAG_HOLD_MS, ...)` runs, then `apply({ type: "transient", kind: "dragged", ... })`.
- `apply()` (CompanionApp.tsx ~512-536) computes `wasPreempted(before, after, now)` from the *machine's* transient states and, when true, calls `directorRef.current.notePreempted(now)` — this runs strictly after the reactDetailed() call above in both paths.

director.ts confirms the mechanism that breaks as a result:
- `reactDetailed()` (lines 238-282) unconditionally does `this.currentAction = { action, startedAt: nowMs }` (line 276) and `this.interrupted = null` (line 277) for *any* successful reaction, including the short click/drag reactions.
- `notePreempted()` (lines 198-212) only builds a resume plan from `this.currentAction`, gated on `remaining > 1_500 && action.durationMs >= 4_000`.

Net effect: by the time `notePreempted()` runs, `this.currentAction` has already been overwritten by the just-created short reaction (700ms poked / 2200ms poked-rapid / 1500ms lifted), all of which fail the resume-worthiness gate. The original long ambient action's identity/remaining time is gone — never recorded, not even rejected-but-logged. Confirmed against the actual `DirectorTables`/`durationMs>=4000` gate in the code, not assumed.

Independent reproduction (real modules imported: director.ts, personality.ts, behavior.ts; no fixtures/mocks of the director's own logic): seeded a long ambient action the *same way the real pump loop does* — via `director.tick()` with a single ambient variant (durationMs 7000) — rather than reusing the finding's own reactDetailed-based seeding, to rule out a self-fulfilling repro.
1. Baseline: seed via tick(), call only `notePreempted()` → next ticks (rng held above hazard so only the resume branch can emit) produce `source: "resume"` — mechanism itself is sound. PASS.
2. Production click order: seed via tick(), then `reactDetailed("poked", now, 700, ...)` (mirrors gameFeel.planClickReaction), then `notePreempted(now)` → 60 subsequent ticks (30s) produce zero `resume` actions. PASS (bug reproduced).
3. Production drag order: seed via tick(), then `reactDetailed("lifted", now, 1500, ..., {cooldownMs:1500})` (mirrors beginDragHold), then `notePreempted(now)` → zero `resume` actions. PASS (bug reproduced).

Also confirmed the regression-coverage gap claim: src/test/rig.test.ts:271 ("長動作被搶佔後可恢復；逾時則放棄") calls `d.notePreempted(...)` directly with no intervening `reactDetailed()` call — it never exercises the actual App ordering, so this gap has no existing test catching it.

Also confirmed spec/doc citations: docs/specs/adaptive-interaction-v05-core-experience-prompt.md:243 states "動作可中斷、可恢復、可取消" (§6.1), and docs/v05-capability-gap-matrix.md (the paragraph containing line ~114) states "Interaction Director→**已有**". The finding's file:line references for CompanionApp.tsx and director.ts all point to the code that actually implements the claimed behavior — no drift found. This is a genuine, currently-live behavioral bug on the two most common interruption paths (click, drag), silently defeating a documented "already have" capability, with no regression test covering the actual call order. Medium severity is reasonable: it's a UX/spec-compliance defect, not a safety-invariant violation.

confirmed.fix: 把 notePreempted 移到反應之前：onPointerUp 先 `directorRef.current.notePreempted(Date.now())`（或讓 apply 先跑、reactDetailed 後跑），beginDragHold 同理；或在 reactDetailed 內不要無條件清 interrupted，改成只在「已經有恢復計畫且新反應本身夠長」時才清，並讓 notePreempted 以「上一個 ambient 動作」而非「剛建立的反應」為對象（例如把 react 產生的 currentAction 與 ambient 產生的分開兩個欄位）。同時補一條回歸測試釘死 App 的實際呼叫順序。
confirmed.regressionTest: Seed a real long ambient action via `InteractionDirector.tick()` (durationMs>=4000, e.g. tailhug/7000), then call `reactDetailed("poked", now, 700, ...)` followed by `notePreempted(now)` (mirroring CompanionApp's actual click-path call order), then run 30s of `tick()` calls and assert zero `source:"resume"` actions appear — this pins the bug (currently 0 resumes) and will start failing once apply()'s notePreempted() is made to run, or capture currentAction, before reactDetailed() runs.

confirmed.title: quiet + Reduced Motion 同時成立時，Director 的安靜分支被 `!ctx.reducedMotion` 整段跳過：眨眼變成一般 performing 演出，角色從「安靜陪伴」坐姿瞬間彈回中性站姿
confirmed.claim: `if (ctx.quiet && !ctx.reducedMotion)` 這個守衛在「安靜時段（或勿擾／quiet-1h）＋系統 Reduced Motion」同時成立時為 false，執行流直接落到下面的 hazard 抽樣與 ambient 選池。shu 的 ambient 表裡唯一 `reducedMotionOk: true` 的變體就是 blink，於是 Director 回傳的是 `{expression:"blink", source:"ambient"}` 而不是 `source:"blink"`；CompanionApp.tsx:1468-1469 的就地眨眼判斷 `gate.quiet && action.source === "blink"` 因此失效，程式落到 :1470-1476 把它套成一般 `performing` transient。pose() 於是從基態 `quiet`（hold `pose:"sit"`、eyeLid 0.35、tailWrap 1、armPose front）切成 `blink`（hold `{}` → DEFAULT_PARAMS.pose = "stand"），而且因為 reducedMotion 讓 timeline.paramsAt 直接 `target = base`、跳過 crossfade 與 pose 過場，這是一次零插值的瞬間跳位——正是 timeline.ts:344-353 blinkNow 註解說「比原本的缺陷更糟」的那個彈回，也違反 §14「Reduced Motion 下保留狀態辨識但減少位移、彈跳與粒子」與 gap matrix:115「Reduced Motion→已有（執行中可切換、真靜態）」。附帶效果：blink 用掉之後永遠留在 `recent.slice(-3)`（池子裡只有它一個），director.ts:332 的防重複把池子永久清空，於是這個組合下「安靜時偶爾眨眼」在整個 session 之後完全停止。
confirmed.evidence:
director.ts:308 `if (ctx.quiet && !ctx.reducedMotion) {`（安靜分支，:311-313 才會回 `source:"blink"`）；:327-334 的 ambient 池只用 `if (ctx.reducedMotion && !v.reducedMotionOk) return false` 過濾，完全不看 ctx.quiet；:332 `if (this.recent.slice(-3).includes(v.expression)) return false`。
shuTables.ts:41 只有 `{ expression: "blink", ..., reducedMotionOk: true }`，:42-50 其餘 9 個都是 false。
CompanionApp.tsx:1468-1469 `const blinkedInPlace = gate.quiet && action.source === "blink" && rig?.blinkNow?.() === true;` → :1470 `if (!blinkedInPlace) apply({type:"transient", kind:"performing", animation: action.expression, durationMs: action.durationMs})`；:1412-1417 directorTickGate 在 base="quiet" 時回 `{tick:true, quiet:true}`（實測印出 `{ tick: true, quiet: true }`）。
rig/expressions.ts:1308-1320 `quiet` hold = `pose:"sit"`；:100-106 `blink` hold = `{}`；rig/params.ts:172 `pose: "stand"`；rig/timeline.ts:396-397 `if (this.reducedMotion) { target = base; }`、:410 `k >= 1 || this.reducedMotion ? target : lerp(...)`。
scratchpad vitest 實測（真實 SHU_DIRECTOR_TABLES、seededRng(7)、4000 tick）：quiet-only → 產出集合 `['blink:blink']`（source=blink，正確）；quiet+reducedMotion → 產出 `['ambient:blink']`，count 1（第一次之後被 recent 永久排除）。
既有測試沒覆蓋這個組合：rig.test.ts:243「quiet 只剩偶爾眨眼」只設 quiet、:250「Reduced Motion 只允許眨眼類」只設 reducedMotion 且只斷言 expression、不斷言 source；grep `quiet: true` ∩ `reducedMotion: true` 在 src/test/ 無命中。

verdicts.reasoning:
All links in the causal chain verified directly against current source plus an independent runtime reproduction:

1. director.ts:308 `if (ctx.quiet && !ctx.reducedMotion) {` — exact line confirmed. When both quiet and reducedMotion are true, this guard is false, so control falls through the quiet block entirely into hazard sampling + ambient pool selection below (lines ~309-334), which filters only on `ctx.reducedMotion && !v.reducedMotionOk` (line ~327) and never looks at `ctx.quiet`.
2. shuTables.ts:41-50 — only `blink` has `reducedMotionOk: true`; the other 9 ambient variants are all `false`. So in the reducedMotion+quiet combo, the ambient pool can select only `blink`, but tagged `source: "ambient"`.
3. CompanionApp.tsx:1468-1470 — `blinkedInPlace = gate.quiet && action.source === "blink"`; since source is now `"ambient"` not `"blink"`, this is false, and the code falls into `apply({type:"transient", kind:"performing", animation: action.expression, ...})` — a general performing transient instead of the in-place blink.
4. expressions.ts — `quiet` hold = `{pose:"sit", ...}` (line ~1308); `blink` hold = `{}` (line ~99), which merges onto `DEFAULT_PARAMS` (params.ts:172 `pose:"stand"`) via `{ ...DEFAULT_PARAMS, ...this.expr.hold }` (timeline.ts:363). So the transient's base pose is "stand", a real jump from "sit".
5. timeline.ts:396-410 — under `this.reducedMotion`, `target = base` directly and `k >= 1 || this.reducedMotion ? target : lerp(...)` skips crossfade — zero interpolation, i.e. an instant teleport, not a reduced-motion-appropriate transition. The `blinkNow()` doc comment (timeline.ts ~348) explicitly names this exact failure mode as "比原本的缺陷更糟" (worse than the original bug) — corroborating this is a known-shape regression, just not closed for this particular combination.
6. director.ts:361 `markUsed` (called only on the ambient-pool path, not on the direct quiet-branch blink return) pushes `blink` into `this.recent`; the pool filter `this.recent.slice(-3).includes(v.expression)` (line ~332) then permanently excludes `blink` from the only-blink-eligible pool for the rest of the session (nothing else is reducedMotionOk), so ambient blinking stops entirely after one occurrence.
7. Independent reproduction (real production code, not mocked): wrote and ran a vitest test directly against `InteractionDirector` + `SHU_DIRECTOR_TABLES` with a seeded RNG over 4000 ticks. quiet-only produced 125 actions, all `blink:blink`. quiet+reducedMotion produced exactly 1 action total, `ambient:blink` (never `blink:blink`), confirming both the source-mislabeling and the permanent exhaustion claim precisely as described.
8. Test-coverage gap confirmed: rig.test.ts:243-247 ("quiet 只剩偶爾眨眼") sets only `quiet:true`; rig.test.ts:250-256 ("Reduced Motion 只允許眨眼類") sets only `reducedMotion:true` and asserts only `.expression`, never `.source`. No test in src/test/ sets both `quiet:true` and `reducedMotion:true` together.
9. Spec cross-reference confirmed: §14 (docs/specs/...:647) "Reduced Motion 下保留狀態辨識但減少位移、彈跳與粒子", and gap-matrix.md:124 "Reduced Motion→已有（執行中可切換、真靜態）" — both consistent with the finding's characterization; the actual behavior in this combo is the opposite (a full un-interpolated pose jump), so the spec-violation framing is accurate, not overstated.

File:line citation (director.ts:308) is exactly correct as of current HEAD — no drift. Severity "medium" is reasonable: it's a real, reproducible, persistent (rest-of-session) presentation regression under a specific but plausible combined condition (quiet + OS Reduced Motion), not a safety/policy-governor violation, so medium rather than high/blocker is appropriate.

confirmed.fix: 把守衛改成 `if (ctx.quiet) { ... }`（安靜優先於 reducedMotion），並在該分支內依 ctx.reducedMotion 決定是回 `source:"blink"` 還是直接 return null（真靜態）；同時檢討 director.ts:332 的防重複在單元素池時的飢餓——例如 `pool.length > 1` 時才套用 recent 過濾。補一條 quiet+reducedMotion 的回歸測試，斷言 `action?.source !== "ambient"`。
confirmed.regressionTest: In rig.test.ts, add a case with `ctx({ quiet: true, reducedMotion: true })` run over many ticks with a real RNG (or the existing seeded pattern) and assert every non-null action has `source === \"blink\"` (not just `expression === \"blink\"`), and that ambient blinking does not permanently stop after the first pick (e.g. it still fires at least once more within a large enough tick budget once cooldown/recent-window has cleared) — or fix the guard to `if (ctx.quiet)` and additionally exempt the direct quiet-branch blink from `recent` pollution, then assert the pool never depends on `recent` when quiet.

confirmed.title: §6 管線的 Utility Scoring 階段在生產環境是恆等式：scoreEvent 的唯一呼叫端把所有情境維度寫死，且等優先競爭可證明恆回 "replace"
confirmed.claim: behavior.ts 的 `scoreEvent`（§6「Utility Scoring」、§6.1「多事件注意力競爭與優先度」）在整個生產程式碼裡只有 machine.ts:151-152 一個呼叫端，而該處把 `recentSameClass: 0`／`alreadyResponded: false`／`interruptible: true`／`doNotDisturb: false`／`relevance: 1` 全部寫死常數——重複懲罰、已回應懲罰、不可中斷懲罰、勿擾成本這四個維度在執行期永遠不生效。更進一步：`transientCompetition` 只在「PRIORITY 相等且非 repeat」時才走到評分分支，而 PRIORITY 相等的每一組（succeeded/unknown、clicked/dragged、waiting-for-receipt/acting，以及同 kind 不同 verified/animation）在 CLASS_OF 下都落在同一個 EventClass，於是 `nextScore = base+10+8 > activeScore = base+10` 恆成立，分支回傳恆為 "replace"。也就是說 §6 管線的 Utility Scoring 這一節在執行期完全等價於 machine.ts:51-65 的靜態 PRIORITY 表，但 docs/v05-capability-gap-matrix.md:114 寫「Interaction Director→**已有**（`react()`/`noteFinished()`/`scoreEvent` 已接進 App；等優先事件用 utility 競爭）」，這是對未生效能力的高估陳述。

verdicts.reasoning:
逐項核實，主張成立，且行號未漂移：

1. 唯一生產呼叫端：`grep -rn scoreEvent apps/interaction-desktop/src` 只命中 machine.ts:10（import）與 machine.ts:151-152（呼叫），其餘全在 src/test/behavior.test.ts。behavior.ts:187 之 scoreEvent 定義與 machine.ts:143-153 之呼叫現場逐字比對，與 finding 引用的程式碼完全一致，無漂移。

2. 情境維度確實寫死：machine.ts:143-150 的 `base` 物件把 recentSameClass=0／alreadyResponded=false／interruptible=true／doNotDisturb=false／relevance=1 全部常數化，只有 novelty 在 nextScore 呼叫時被覆寫成 1。behavior.ts:190-193 對應的四個懲罰分支（重複／已回應／不可中斷／勿擾）因此在這條路徑上永遠不會觸發非零懲罰——只有 behavior.test.ts:103-106 用手造 ctx 直接測 scoreEvent 本身，未經過 machine.ts。

3. 「等優先必回傳 replace」用真實原始碼獨立重現，而非只信任 finding 的敘述：我在 scratchpad 寫了一份 vitest 測試，直接 `import { transientCompetition } from "../companion/machine"`（真實檔案，非重寫邏輯），暫置於 src/test/__tmp_review_exhaustive.test.ts 執行後隨即刪除（git status 確認未殘留）。窮舉三個「同優先組」（succeeded/unknown、clicked/dragged、waiting-for-receipt/acting）＋所有 13 種 kind 的「同 kind 但 verified/animation 不同」非 repeat 樣本，共 **1422** 筆（與 finding 引用數字完全一致），輸出結果集合唯一值為 `['replace']`。數學推導也印證這必然成立：因為 PRIORITY 相等的每一組在 CLASS_OF 下也剛好都對到同一個 EventClass（succeeded/unknown 皆 task-state、clicked/dragged 皆 direct-interaction、waiting-for-receipt/acting 皆 task-state；其餘 PRIORITY 值互不相同，pa===pe 只在 kind 相同時成立，此時 CLASS_OF 顯然相同），於是 nextScore−activeScore 恆等於 relevance/repeat 項相消後的 novelty 差 = 0+8 = +8，恆為正。

4. 文件誇大陳述屬實：docs/v05-capability-gap-matrix.md:114（§9，明白聲明「以下記錄本輪實際變化；每一句『已有』都對應程式碼＋測試」）寫「`scoreEvent` 已接進 App；等優先事件用 utility 競爭」，但同一份文件在別處（Phase 2 快照 docs/v05-recovery-matrix.md:274）自己曾把同一機制評為「Utility 評分是死碼…只有固定優先度替換（非競爭/排隊）」🟠 high。Phase 7 之後 scoreEvent 從零呼叫變成一個呼叫端，但因情境全寫死，其可鑑別力仍是零——本質上還是「固定優先度替換」，只是多包了一層看似在算分的外殼。director.ts:6-10 的檔頭註解本身誠實得多，承認 scoreEvent「只被 machine.ts 用在同優先 transient 的平手判定」，但 gap-matrix 的措辭（「用 utility 競爭」）沒有揭露這個平手判定在生產詞彙下是恆定結果，容易讓讀者誤以為 doNotDisturb／重複懲罰等維度真的在跑。

這是一個可獨立重現、證據具體到行號與窮舉樣本數的真缺陷（文件對未生效能力的措辭過度樂觀），而非風格/主觀/已被涵蓋的防護。medium 嚴重度合理：不涉及安全不變量（truthState／verified／estop 皆不受影響），純粹是「§6 Utility Scoring 管線的能力矩陣措辭」與「其實現退化為常數」之間的落差。

confirmed.fix: 二選一，別留中間狀態：(a) 真的接上——把 recentSameClass（同 class 最近 10 分鐘次數）、alreadyResponded（同 correlationId 是否已演過）、interruptible（cap.interruptible／PREEMPTING_EXPRESSIONS）、doNotDisturb（quietHours/DND/quiet-1h）從 CompanionApp 的既有狀態餵進 transientCompetition，讓評分真的能翻轉結果；或 (b) 誠實刪除——把等優先平手直接寫成 `return "replace"`，移除 scoreEvent 的生產呼叫，並把 gap matrix:114、docs/acceptance-evidence.md 的「等優先事件用 utility 競爭」改成已知限制。
confirmed.regressionTest: 窮舉 13 種 TransientKind × {verified, animation} 對每一組「PRIORITY 相等且非 repeat」呼叫真實 transientCompetition，斷言結果集合必須包含至少一個非 'replace' 值（例如令 doNotDisturb=true 或 alreadyResponded=true 時應回 'keep'）——目前該斷言會失敗，因為 machine.ts 呼叫端把這些維度硬編為停用值。

confirmed.title: TS 視窗 Gateway 的 renegotiate 不把 pending 標 uncertain、不補安全 intent 的 system.text（與 Rust 權威端與 README §7 不一致）
confirmed.claim: `renegotiate()` 只呼叫 `handshake()`，而 `handshake()` 完全不碰 `inst.pending`、不遞增 `inst.generation`、不發任何 `uncertain` 回執、也不對進行中的安全 intent 補 `system.text`。README §7 明訂「重新協商（negotiate）：pending 一律 uncertain，其中還在演的安全 intent 比照斷線補 system.text」，Rust 權威實作照做了；TS 鏡射沒有。實務觸發點是 CompanionApp 的 Reduced Motion 切換（CompanionApp.tsx:830、839），此時 `inst.negotiated.resolutions` 被整份換掉，但仍在演的命令保留舊的 `p.resolution`／`p.effective`——即使該能力在新協商下已是 `disabled`／`unsupported`，它仍會以舊的 `exact` resolution 回 `completed`，安全 intent 也因此拿不到 system.text 補送。
confirmed.evidence:
apps/interaction-desktop/src/character/gateway.ts:437-442 `renegotiate()` → 406-435 `handshake()`：只做 `lifecycle(negotiating)`、`adapter.negotiate(hello)`、`runNegotiate(...)`、`inst.negotiated = negotiated`、重新訂閱 onInput、`lifecycle(ready)`。
對照 crates/interaction-character/src/gateway.rs:551-568：`mark_all_uncertain(inst, "re-negotiated", ...)` + `resend_safety_as_system_text(...)` + `inst.generation += 1`。
實測（scratchpad 探針）：註冊一個只回 accepted/started 的 adapter，dispatch 一則 `emergency`（pending=1）後呼叫 `gw.renegotiate("a")` → `generation 1 -> 1, pending: 1, systemText: 0, uncertainReceipts: 0`。
現有測試 apps/interaction-desktop/src/test/character-gateway.test.ts:228-238 只驗 resolution 變化與 generation 不變，沒有覆蓋 pending／安全補送。

verdicts.reasoning:
確認為真實缺陷，且以獨立實測驗證。

靜態證據：
- gateway.ts:437-442 `renegotiate()` 目前內容仍是「只呼叫 `handshake()`」，行號未漂移。
- gateway.ts:406-435 `handshake()` 完全不碰 `inst.pending`、不遞增 `inst.generation`、不呼叫 `systemText`；只做 lifecycle(negotiating) → adapter.negotiate → runNegotiate → 設定 inst.negotiated → 重訂閱 onInput → lifecycle(ready)。
- 對照同檔 541-588 `tearDown`（disconnect／crash 路徑）：確實會把所有 pending 標 `uncertain`、對 `p.safety` 的項目呼叫 `systemText`、並 `inst.generation = staleGeneration + 1`——證明「斷線有做、重新協商沒做」的不對稱是真的，不是我誤讀。
- Rust 權威端 `crates/interaction-character/src/gateway.rs` 的 `on_negotiate`（約 500-580 行）在 `inst.negotiated.is_some() || inst.live_pending() > 0` 時會呼叫 `mark_all_uncertain` + `resend_safety_as_system_text` + `inst.generation += 1`，程式碼註解原文就是「重新協商後不重投先前的真相，所以這裡比照斷線補 `system.text`」——與 finding 引用的行為一致。
- README §7（`docs/character-protocol/README.md:251`）明文規定：「重新協商（negotiate）：pending 一律 `uncertain`，其中還在演的安全 intent 比照斷線補 `system.text`——adapter 不能靠重送 negotiate 讓安全訊息無聲消失。」這是規格對 TS 鏡射的明確約束，TS 端未落實。
- 真實觸發點確認：`CompanionApp.tsx:830` 與 `:839` 在 Reduced Motion 系統設定變化時呼叫 `gateway.renegotiate(PRIMARY_INSTANCE_ID)`，是正式產品路徑，非假設情境。
- 既有測試 `character-gateway.test.ts:228-238` 不僅未覆蓋 pending／安全 intent，第 237 行 `expect(h.gw.getInstance("a")?.generation).toBe(1)` 反而把「renegotiate 後 generation 不變」的現況行為釘死成通過的斷言——證實現狀從未被要求符合 README §7。

實測驗證（自建最小回歸腳本，vitest 執行，事後已刪除）：
1. 建一個只回 accepted/started（永不 completed）的 HoldAdapter，registerInstance 後 generation=1。
2. dispatch 一則 `emergency`（安全 intent）envelope，此時 pendingCount=1。
3. 呼叫 `gw.renegotiate("a")`。
4. 實測輸出：`{ genBefore: 1, genAfter: 1, pendingBefore: 1, pendingAfter: 1, uncertainReceipts: 0, systemTextCount: 0, receiptStatuses: ['accepted','started'] }`。

與 finding 描述的探針結果（generation 1→1、pending:1、systemText:0、uncertainReceipts:0）完全吻合，親自重現成立。

嚴重度維持 medium：需要「安全 intent 恰好在 renegotiate 當下仍在演」的時序才會觸發，且該 intent 本身仍留在 pending map（未直接遺失），但確實違反 README §7 的明文契約與 Rust 權威端的行為，且有真實生產觸發點（Reduced Motion 切換），影響誠實階梯（安全訊息可能在新協商降級後仍以舊 resolution 回 completed，且不補 system.text）。

confirmed.fix: 在 `renegotiate()`（或 `handshake()` 偵測到 `inst.negotiated !== null || inst.pending.size > 0` 時）先把所有 pending 以 `uncertain` 結清（走 `finalize`／等價路徑，讓 `p.safety` 觸發 system.text，messageId 用 `<原 id>/system-text` 與 Rust 一致），再套用新的 negotiated；若要維持 generation 不變，至少要在文件與測試裡把「TS 端 renegotiate 不換代」寫成明確約定，並補上 pending→uncertain＋安全補送的行為與回歸測試。

confirmed.title: 外部 adapter outbound 佇列滿時，安全訊息以無界 detached task 排隊；WebSocket 寫入無逾時，close token 叫不醒被卡住的迴圈
confirmed.claim: `send_external()` 在有界（32）mpsc 滿載時，對非安全訊息誠實丟棄，但對安全訊息改用 `handle.spawn(async move { tx.send(message).await })`——每一則安全訊息都會生出一個沒有上限、沒有逾時的 detached task 停在 `send` 上。同時 `character_ws_loop` 的 `send_wire(...).await` 沒有寫入逾時：對端若停止讀取（TCP 反壓），迴圈會卡在 outbound 分支的 `await` 裡，select 不再輪詢，`session.close.cancelled()` 與 idle deadline 都醒不過來，`sweep` 的 `conn.close.cancel()`（character.rs:1509-1513）也無效。於是 rx 永不被清空、parked task 只增不減，違反「禁止無界 queue、長時工作必須有 TTL／watchdog」。此外這些延遲送出的訊息與後續 try_send 成功的訊息會亂序上線（例如 cancel 越過它的 intent）。
confirmed.evidence:
crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs:739-767：`Err(TrySendError::Full(message))` → `droppable` 為 false（安全 intent／negotiated／hello／cancel／goodbye）時無條件 `handle.spawn(... tx.send(message).await)`，沒有計數、沒有 timeout、沒有丟棄策略。
crates/interaction-api/src/character_ws.rs:90-104：`outbound = session.rx.recv()` 分支內直接 `send_wire(&mut sink, &message).await`，`send_wire`（:61-68）是無逾時的 `sink.send(...).await`；一旦阻塞，:82 的 `session.close.cancelled()` 與 :86 的 `idle_deadline` 都不再被輪詢。
crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs:1495-1513 的 sweep 只做 `conn.close.cancel()`，對已卡在 `sink.send` 的 task 沒有效果（socket 也不會被 close，因為 :148 的 `sink.close()` 在迴圈之後）。

verdicts.reasoning: Read crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs and crates/interaction-api/src/character_ws.rs directly; every cited line matches current content with zero drift (anchor line 755 = `match tokio::runtime::Handle::try_current() {`, evidence range 739-767 = the full try_send/Full/droppable/spawn block; character_ws.rs 61-68 = send_wire with a bare `sink.send(...).await` and no timeout wrapper; 90-104 = the `outbound = session.rx.recv()` select branch calling `send_wire(...).await` inside the match arm body; character.rs 1509-1513 = sweep's `conn.close.cancel()`). Confirmed mechanism: (1) OUTBOUND_CAP=32 (character.rs:50) bounded mpsc; on Full, non-droppable messages (safety Intent, Hello/Negotiate/Negotiated/Cancel/Goodbye/Receipt/Event/Lifecycle — droppable is only true for non-safety Intent, Heartbeat, Error per the match at 742-746) are handed to `handle.spawn(async move { tx.send(message).await })` with no count cap, no timeout, no dedupe. (2) `character_ws_loop`'s `tokio::select!` matches the `outbound` branch then runs `send_wire(&mut sink, &message).await` as sequential code inside that match arm — standard tokio::select! semantics: once a branch is chosen, subsequent `.await` points inside its body are not re-entrant into the select's concurrent polling, so a blocked `sink.send` (e.g. TCP backpressure when the peer stops reading) stalls the whole loop, including `session.close.cancelled()` and the idle-deadline branch. (3) `character_sweep_at`'s only remedy is `conn.close.cancel()` (1510), which only affects the *next* select! iteration — ineffective while stuck mid-await; `sink.close()` (character_ws.rs ~148) only runs after the loop breaks, so the socket itself is never force-closed either. (4) While stalled, `rx` is never drained, so any detached spawn from (1) also cannot progress, and more such tasks keep accumulating for as long as the peer stays half-open. (5) No global TimeoutLayer wraps this router (checked crates/interaction-api/src/lib.rs — only RequestBodyLimitLayer and cors_layer), and WS upgrades bypass generic HTTP timeouts anyway. (6) No test in character.rs's `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` (2249-2472) or in crates/interaction-api/tests/api_e2e.rs's single character_ws test (line 1546) exercises a full-channel or slow/blocked-consumer scenario, so nothing guards this today. The claimed reordering risk is also structurally real: the truth-projection/apply path calls `hub.send_external` synchronously in a plain loop over generated outputs; when a call hits Full and spawns a detached task, that task's actual channel insertion happens on the tokio scheduler's own timing, independent of whatever `send_external` call runs next in the same synchronous loop — a later message (including a Cancel, which is always non-droppable) can win a `try_send` race and land in the channel before an earlier spawned safety message's `tx.send().await` completes, so wire order does not correlate with call order. This is a genuine, currently-unfixed violation of the project's "long-running work needs TTL/watchdog, no unbounded queues" invariant, correctly localized and not overstated.

confirmed.fix: (1) 給 `send_wire` 加寫入逾時（例如 `tokio::time::timeout(HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS, ...)`），逾時即視為 TransportClosed 跳出迴圈；(2) `send_external` 的安全訊息改為有界處理：維護每個 instance 的 deferred 計數上限（或用一條容量固定的 overflow 佇列），超過上限就記 audit 並讓 gateway 以 `uncertain` 誠實結清該命令、必要時落到 `system.text`，不要無限 spawn；(3) 每個 deferred send 加 TTL，過期即放棄並回報。

confirmed.title: 輸入事件不受協商後的 inputCapabilities 管制：宣告「不接收任何輸入」的角色仍能產生 text-submitted／file-dropped／action-requested 觀察
confirmed.claim: TS `ingestInput()` 與 Rust `Gateway::on_event()` 都只檢查 generation／event kind／role／速率，完全不比對協商出來的 `inputCapabilities`。但使用者在角色連接頁看到的「可以接收：…」正是由 `manifest.inputCapabilities` 產生（registry.ts:261-274、Runtime `supported_input_capabilities`）。因此一個匯入角色的 manifest 可以宣告 `inputCapabilities: {}`（UI 顯示「可以接收：不接收任何輸入」），實際上仍會收到點擊／拖曳／文字／檔案拖放，並在桌面 instance 上經 `character_input_to_observation` 變成 `companion.conversation`／`companion.drag-drop`／`companion.quick-action` 觀察，還會鑄出 file-drop grant。宣告與實際不一致，等於給使用者一個不成立的承諾。
confirmed.evidence:
apps/interaction-desktop/src/character/gateway.ts:1241-1345 `ingestInput()`：checks `live()`、`raw.generation`、`isInputEventKind`、`INPUT_SILENT_ROLES`、`rateAllows`，之後直接進 kind switch，沒有任何 `negotiated.capabilities`／`inputCapabilities` 比對。
crates/interaction-character/src/gateway.rs:1216-1237 `on_event()` 同樣只檢查 generation／instance id／protocol version 後就 `inst.input.push(...)`。
crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs:2095-2235 `character_input_to_observation()` 依 kind 直接映射到 `companion.*` 受器（僅對 `InstanceOrigin::External` 拒絕）。
UI 宣告來源：apps/interaction-desktop/src/character/registry.ts:261-274（`可以接收：不接收任何輸入`）、crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs:476-482 + :594。
實測（scratchpad 探針）：manifest `inputCapabilities: {}` 註冊後由 adapter 送出三則事件 → `delivered events: ["character.text-submitted","character.file-dropped","character.action-requested"]`，且 `gw.listGrants()` 產生了 `{name:"a.png", grantId:"grant-2"}`。

verdicts.reasoning:
Independently traced the full path end-to-end and the claim holds in the current source.

1. TS `ingestInput()` (apps/interaction-desktop/src/character/gateway.ts:1241-1345) checks only: instance liveness, `raw.generation`, `isInputEventKind`, `INPUT_SILENT_ROLES` (observer/notification-only), and the 50 msg/s rate limiter — then dispatches straight into the `kind` switch (hover/drag/text-submitted/file-dropped/action-requested/...) and calls `this.deliver(...)`. No reference anywhere in the function to `inst.negotiated.capabilities` or `inst.adapter.manifest.inputCapabilities`.

2. Rust `Gateway::on_event()` (crates/interaction-character/src/gateway.rs:1220-1241, function body confirmed by direct read) checks only: unknown instance, `event.generation`, `event.character_instance_id`, protocol-version major — then `inst.input.push(event, ...)`. Same absence of any `input_capabilities` check. `grep` across interaction-character/interaction-runtime confirms `input_capabilities`/`inputCapabilities` is used *only* for: (a) negotiation's `intersect()` into the merged/effective capabilities record used for output-channel resolution bookkeeping, (b) wire (de)serialization, (c) manifest validation, and (d) the purely-informational `supported_input_capabilities()` reporting helper that feeds the connect-page "可以接收：…" line and the `GET /v1/character/instances|adapters` API fields. The existing Rust unit test `input_capabilities_and_security_flags_come_from_the_manifest` (crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs:2256) explicitly documents this as a *display*-only function ("連接頁「可以接收」只列 manifest 宣告…"), with no companion test anywhere asserting `on_event`/`ingestInput` rejects an event whose capability isn't declared supported — confirming no enforcement exists, by design or omission.

3. `character_input_to_observation()` (crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs:2095-2235) maps every drained event kind straight to a `companion.*` receptor (click/text-input/quick-action/drag-drop with real file grants) and only special-cases `InstanceOrigin::External` (WebSocket adapter-token adapters) for a hard "not observed" audit-only path — `Builtin` and `Imported` origins both get real observations regardless of what their manifest declared for `inputCapabilities`.

4. Traced who actually calls `ingestInput`/pushes events on the desktop: it is not (in practice) the adapter's own `onInput(cb)` hook that gates this — `CompanionApp.tsx`'s host-level DOM/pointer handlers (`onPointerDown/Move/Up`, hover-approach/leave, `submitText`, `dropPush`) call `pushInteraction(...)` → `gatewayRef.current.ingestInput(PRIMARY_INSTANCE_ID, ev)` directly and unconditionally whenever `feedRef.current === "protocol"`, with zero reference to `manifest.inputCapabilities` or `negotiated.capabilities` anywhere in that call chain (the only related gate found, `dragEnabledRef`, is an unrelated user preference toggle for window-dragging, not a manifest capability check). So even for a character whose manifest declares `inputCapabilities: {}`, clicking/dragging/typing into/dropping a file on the desktop companion window will still generate `companion.clicked`/`companion.dragged`/`companion.text-input`/`companion.drag-drop` observations and real short-lived file grants.

5. The UI text the finding cites is real and is presented as a factual capability claim: `registry.ts:261-274` builds "可以接收：不接收任何輸入" / "Can receive: no input" straight from `manifest.inputCapabilities`, and this string is surfaced verbatim to users on the character catalog card (`pages/character/catalog.ts:201-204`) and the connect page (`pages/connect/CharacterAdaptersSection.tsx:234-237`).

6. Checked the CPP contract (docs/character-protocol/README.md §6, §9) and the adapter-authoring guide for any documented promise that the Gateway enforces `inputCapabilities` before converting events to observations — no such requirement exists; the only enforcement mechanics documented/implemented are per-kind rate limiting/queue caps, role filtering (observer/notification-only), and the categorical `origin == External` block. The manifest's `inputCapabilities` was evidently designed/tested purely as a UI-facing declaration, never wired into the input-acceptance path — exactly the gap the finding describes.

The claim is therefore a real, currently-existing behavior (not something already fixed elsewhere or covered by an existing test), reproducible purely by reading the code paths (no daemon needed): a manifest that declares no supported input capabilities still results in real `companion.*` observations and file grants once the desktop window (or, per the same code path, any registered adapter) fires input events, contradicting the UI's "can receive: no input" claim shown to the user. Medium severity is reasonable: it is a broken user-facing declarative promise / honesty-ladder-adjacent gap (not a hardware/policy/verification bypass, no `unwrap()` panic risk, no ability to forge `verified` or escalate consent) — the current concrete exploitation surface is limited to the three trusted first-party builtin adapters (shu-rig/sprite/text) since there is no third-party in-process module loader implemented yet (`buildAdapter` in CompanionApp.tsx only ever instantiates `TextCharacterAdapter`/`SpriteCharacterAdapter`/`ShuCharacterAdapter`), but a third-party *manifest* (data only, no code) can still declare a false `inputCapabilities: {}` and have it rendered by a trusted builtin adapter whose actual behavior ignores that declaration.

confirmed.fix: 在兩端的事件入口加一道能力閘：event kind → 所需 input capability（clicked/double-clicked→input.click、hover-*→input.hover、drag-started/dragged→input.drag、dropped→input.drop、text-submitted→input.text、file-dropped→input.fileDrop、toy-thrown→gameplay.toys…），協商結果沒有該能力就丟棄並記 audit（`input-capability-not-declared`），與 role 過濾同層處理；或反過來讓 UI 文案改成「host 表面可送出的互動」而不是宣稱角色的接收範圍——但前者才符合「宣告即契約」。
confirmed.regressionTest: Register a gateway instance with a manifest declaring `inputCapabilities: {}` (all unsupported) and negotiate it, then call `gateway.ingestInput(instanceId, {kind:"character.text-submitted", payload:{text:"hi"}, ...})` (TS) / `gw.on_event(...)` + `character_input_to_observation` (Rust) and assert the event is rejected/audited rather than delivered as a `companion.text-input` observation — today it asserts false (delivered) because no code path checks `inputCapabilities`/`negotiated.capabilities` before dispatch.

confirmed.title: 一般模式記憶清單只取最新 200 筆再在前端分類，會對使用者說「這個分類目前沒有記憶」的假話
confirmed.claim: 一般模式的「關於我的記憶」以 `api.memoryList(undefined, 200)` 一次抓全層最新 200 筆，再在瀏覽器端依人話分組過濾。後端依 `updated_at DESC` 截斷，回傳的 `count` 是「這次回了幾筆」而非資料庫總數，前端也沒有任何截斷提示。因此當記憶總數超過 200 筆時，某個分類的記憶若不在最新 200 筆內，畫面會直接印出「這個分類目前沒有記憶。」——這是主動說錯話，不是漏講；而同一台機器切到進階模式（走後端 layer 過濾）卻看得到那些記憶，兩個模式互相打臉。
confirmed.evidence:
MemoryKnowledgePage.tsx:144 `() => api.memoryList(advanced ? layer || undefined : undefined, 200)`；:230-238 `const shown = advanced ? items : items.filter(...)` → `if (shown.length === 0) return

這個分類目前沒有記憶。

`。後端 crates/interaction-runtime/src/memory.rs:115-129 `memory_list` 只回 `{"items": items, "count": items.len()}`（無總數）；crates/interaction-storage/src/lib.rs:1054-1080 `list_memory` 為 `ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT ?`。總量會自然超過 200：crates/interaction-runtime/src/curator.rs `record_task_experience` 對每個關閉的 agent session 寫一筆 TaskMemory，而 `default_retention(TaskMemory)`（interaction-core/src/memory.rs:88-91）只有 90 天 reviewAfter、沒有 expiresAt，永不自動清除。專案在別處已把同一件事做對：`memory_export` 用 `count_memory` 產生 `limitReached`（memory.rs:170-215）、`memory_context_bundle` 產生 `limits.scanLimitReached`（memory.rs:236-238、340-345），且 src/test/pendingCountExact.test.tsx 明文釘死「數字只是下限時任何介面都不得說『目前沒有』」——記憶清單是同一類問題卻沒有這層誠實。

verdicts.reasoning:
逐行核對原始碼，finding 的每一項技術主張皆成立且行號精準無漂移：

1. apps/interaction-desktop/src/pages/MemoryKnowledgePage.tsx:144 — `api.memoryList(advanced ? layer || undefined : undefined, 200)`，一般模式固定不帶 layer、抓全層最新 200 筆。
2. src/api.ts:198-199 — `memoryList` 呼叫 Tauri `memory_list` command，帶 `limit`。
3. crates/interaction-runtime/src/memory.rs:115-130 — `memory_list` 只回 `{"items": items, "count": items.len()}`；`count` 是本次回傳筆數，不是資料庫總數。對照同檔 `memory_export`（用 `count_memory` 產生 `limitReached`）與 `memory_context_bundle`（`scanLimitReached`），可見專案在其它 API 已把「截斷要誠實回報」做對，唯獨 `memory_list` 沒有。
4. crates/interaction-storage/src/lib.rs:1054-1083 — `list_memory` 是 `ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT ?`，`count_memory`（1092 起）才是真總數，`memory_list` 未呼叫它。
5. MemoryKnowledgePage.tsx:230-238 — `shown = advanced ? items : items.filter(...)`，`shown.length === 0` 時印出「這個分類目前沒有記憶。」，全檔 grep count/total/截斷/下限/至少 找不到任何截斷提示。StateView 對非陣列的 `{items,count}` 物件一律呼叫 children，過濾與空狀態訊息完全由這段元件邏輯決定。
6. 資料量會自然超過 200 屬實：curator.rs `record_task_experience`（579-610）在每個 agent session 關閉時寫一筆 `MemoryLayer::TaskMemory`；`default_retention`（interaction-core/src/memory.rs:88-91）只給 `review_after: days(90)`、無 `expires_at`，因此 TaskMemory 永不自動過期／清除，長期使用下總筆數無上限成長，且被 GENERAL_GROUP_OF_LAYER 併入最容易被擠出最新 200 窗口的「work」分組。
7. 進階模式打臉一般模式：進階模式對 `memory_list` 帶明確 `layer`，後端變成「該 layer 自己的最新 200 筆」，範圍遠比「全層混合最新 200 筆」寬，同一台機器、同一批資料下很可能看到一般模式因故被擠出窗口而『沒有』的那些記憶。
8. 專案已有明文先例證明這類「數字只是下限就不能說『沒有』」是違規：src/test/pendingCountExact.test.tsx 對 activity inbox 精確釘死同一原則，且 activityInbox 有 `totalBeforeLimit` 誠實回報截斷；`memory_list`／MemoryKnowledgePage 沒有對應機制或測試覆蓋（翻遍 regressions-*.test.tsx 皆只 mock `items`/`count` 為回傳筆數，未驗證真實總數與截斷提示）。

未發現任何反駁材料：沒有隱藏的總數欄位、沒有前端另外呼叫 count 端點、沒有測試鎖死正確行為、程式碼在我審查當下即是這個狀態（非審查期間被平行修復）。這是一個真實、可重現的誠實階梯違規：後端能截斷卻不誠實回報總數／limitReached，前端把「這 200 筆裡沒有」講成「這個分類沒有」，違反 CLAUDE.md 的誠實階梯不變量。

confirmed.fix: `memory_list` 比照 `memory_export` 回 `total`（`count_memory`）與 `limitReached`；一般模式改為後端分組過濾（或先取 count 再抓），並在達到上限時顯示「只看了最近更新的 N 條，更舊的沒有列出」；空清單文案在 `limitReached` 為真時不得說「目前沒有記憶」。`knowledge_list`（UI 上限 100）與 `asset_list(200)`（interaction-api/src/routes.rs:2018-2020，UI 完全不帶 limit）有同樣的無聲截斷，一併處理。

confirmed.title: cancel 把裝置的任何錯誤翻成確定結論「device reports no cancellable effect」
confirmed.claim: LinkActuator::cancel 的 `Ok(_)` 分支同時吃下 `DeviceMsg::Err`，把「裝置明確拒絕／根本沒處理這則 cancel」講成「裝置回報沒有可取消的效果」。參考韌體在 BLE write 被丟棄時送的是沒有 id 的 `err busy`（該 cancel 從未被處理，震動／蜂鳴仍在跑），DeviceLink::cancel 在這條 link 只有它一個等待者時會認領這則匿名 err 並以 Ok 回傳；`err not-paired`（裝置重開機、MQTT 連線未變）同樣落進這一格。結果是在安全路徑上給出一個裝置從未做過的確定宣稱——protocol.rs:832-838 的註解本身就把這個失敗模式列為不可接受，但修的只是歸屬邏輯，link_caps 這一層仍在演。
confirmed.evidence: link_caps.rs:412-414 `Ok(_) => Err(ActuatorError::NotFound(format!("{action_id}: device reports no cancellable effect")))` —— 與其上方只匹配 `Ack{cancelled: Some(true)}` 的分支互補，因此 `DeviceMsg::Err` 必定落在這裡。protocol.rs:836-848（cancel 的 pick）`DeviceMsg::Err { id: Some(id), .. } if id == action_id => Some(m.clone())` 與 `DeviceMsg::Err { id: None, reason } if self.in_flight.load(..) <= 1 => Some(m.clone())` 證明 Err 會以 `Ok(reply)` 回到呼叫端。firmware/esp32-companion/esp32-companion.ino:1002 `if (g_bleDropBusy) { g_bleDropBusy = false; sendErr(LINK_BLE, nullptr, "busy"); }`（write 被丟掉、cancel 沒被處理）；:800 `sendErr(link, id[0] ? id : nullptr, "not-paired")`（cancel 走的是需配對分支）；:831 `sendErr(link, id, "not-found")` 才是真的「沒有可取消的效果」。runtime.rs:867-880 會把這個字串原封不動寫進收據的 `cancel_unconfirmed` 與 `action.cancelled` audit 的 detail。

verdicts.reasoning:
親自追蹤了整條路徑，claim 成立：

1. link_caps.rs:412-414（目前檔案內容與 finding 引用行號一致，無漂移）：
   `Ok(_) => Err(ActuatorError::NotFound(format!("{action_id}: device reports no cancellable effect")))`
   這個 `_` 通配符丟棄了整個 `DeviceMsg` 的內容，完全不看 `Err{reason}` 實際是什麼。

2. protocol.rs:830-848 的 `cancel()` 中，`wait_reply` 的 picker：
   - `DeviceMsg::Err{id:Some(id),..} if id==action_id` → 歸屬給這次 cancel（不論 reason 是什麼字串，如 "not-paired"）
   - `DeviceMsg::Err{id:None, reason}` 在 `self.in_flight.load(..) <= 1` 時同樣被認領（Ok(_.clone())）
   兩者都會讓 `cancel()` 回傳 `Ok(DeviceMsg::Err{..})`，落進 link_caps.rs 的 `Ok(_)` 分支。

3. `in_flight` 計數器是每條 `DeviceLink`（每台裝置連線）共用，不是每次呼叫獨立——單純呼叫一次 cancel（沒有並行 cmd）時 in_flight==1 是最常見情境，不是邊角案例。

4. 韌體 firmware/esp32-companion/esp32-companion.ino 證實至少兩種與「沒有可取消的效果」語意完全無關的 err 會落入這個路徑：
   - :991-1002 `g_bleDropBusy`：BLE 接收佇列滿，write 在解析 JSON 之前就被丟棄，裝置根本沒看到這則 cancel（震動／蜂鳴仍在跑），之後才由 loop() 送出**無 id** 的 `err busy`。
   - :798-800 `sendErr(link, id[0]?id:nullptr, "not-paired")`：cancel 走「其餘訊息一律要求已配對」分支，此時 doc["id"] 就是 cancel 的 action_id（`HostMsg::Cancel{id}` 序列化會帶 id），所以送出的是**有 id** 的 `err not-paired`，同樣落進 `Ok(_)` → 同一句「no cancellable effect」。
   - 真正對應「no cancellable effect」語意的只有 :831 `sendErr(link, id, "not-found")`（裝置解析成功、確定沒有這個 id 在跑）。

5. 決定性的第三方證據：`tests/protocol_honesty.rs:1512-1546` 這個既有測試，本身就是用 **id-less "not-paired"** 當範例，斷言「取消結果未知就要說未知，不能說『沒有可取消的效果』」——但這個測試刻意安排了並行 cmd 讓 in_flight>1（觸發 protocol.rs 的「無法歸屬」路徑，回 `LinkError::Timeout` 帶 `UNKNOWN`），完全沒有覆蓋 in_flight<=1（單純一次 cancel）時、同樣的 id-less "not-paired" 會被*歸屬*（這部分刻意設計正確）之後、在 link_caps.rs 這層被*語意錯譯*成同一句被測試明文禁止的「沒有可取消的效果」的情況。測試本身的存在反而證明維護者已經認知並明文禁止這句話出現在「結果未知」的情境，只是修補範圍沒有涵蓋到 link_caps.rs 這一層與 in_flight<=1 這個更常見的分支。

6. 下游影響（runtime.rs:850-914）：`Ok(Err(e))` → `unconfirmed = Some(format!("driver did not confirm the cancel: {e}"))`，最終狀態仍正確落在 `ActionStatus::Uncertain`（不是 Cancelled，頂層誠實階梯沒被打破），但 `cancel_unconfirmed` 的 push_error 與 `action.cancelled` audit 的 `detail` 欄位會寫入這句對「busy／not-paired」而言不實的具體宣稱——這正是「inference≠fact」的範疇：把裝置沒表態或明確拒絕的狀態，寫成裝置對「有沒有可取消效果」表過態的確定結論，可能誤導看 audit 記錄的人以為裝置已確認沒有殘留效果。

我判定 confirmed=true，severity 維持 medium（不是 blocker/high，因為頂層狀態機沒有謊報 Cancelled；但寫入安全相關 audit trail 的具體字句確實不實，值得修）。

confirmed.fix: 把 `Ok(DeviceMsg::Err { reason, .. })` 拆成獨立分支：只有 `reason == "not-found"` 才回 NotFound「裝置回報沒有可取消的效果」；其餘（busy／not-paired／bad-json／unknown-type 與所有匿名 err）改回 `ActuatorError::Unavailable(format!("裝置拒絕了取消請求（{reason}）——效果狀態 UNKNOWN"))`，與 `Err(e)` 分支同一語氣。
confirmed.regressionTest: 仿照 tests/protocol_honesty.rs 既有的 `a_concurrent_cmd_makes_an_id_less_error_unattributable_to_the_cancel`，改成**不**啟動並行 cmd（讓 in_flight==1）、只送一次 cancel，然後由 MockRawLink 送出 id-less 的 `err busy`（或帶正確 id 的 `err not-paired`）；斷言 DeclarativeActuator::cancel 回傳的錯誤訊息不得包含「no cancellable effect」（或斷言其變體為 Unavailable/Uncertain 而非把 reason 丟棄的 NotFound）。

confirmed.title: 續開把宣告的 toolScope 縮到空集合，卻讓實際的 provider 工具集變寬（--tools "" → --tools Read,Glob,Grep）
confirmed.claim: `check_resume_not_wider` 只比對「宣告字串向量的子集關係」，而 `gateway_attach` 是用 `record.tool_scope == ["conversation.generate"]` 這個精確等值推導 `disable_tools`。介面與 CLI 的續開都送 `toolScope: []`，`[] ⊆ ["conversation.generate"]` 因此通過檢查，但 claude 的實際參數從 `--tools ""`（全部停用）變成 `--tools Read,Glob,Grep`（可讀檔／glob／grep）。宣告更窄、實權更寬，正好是這個函式文件宣稱要擋的「省略＝放寬」。
confirmed.evidence: 1) agents.rs:108-120：`extra(&input.tool_scope, &original.tool_scope)` 只檢查「請求裡有、上次沒有」的項目；空集合永遠通過。2) gateway.rs:310：`spec.disable_tools = record.tool_scope == ["conversation.generate"];`（精確等值，續開時 tool_scope 為 [] ⇒ false）。3) claude.rs:93-101：`else if spec.disable_tools { --tools "" } else { --tools Read,Glob,Grep }`。4) 續開請求確實送空 toolScope：apps/interaction-desktop/src/pages/AiPage.tsx:121 `toolScope: []`（`buildResumeInput`），crates/interaction-cli/src/commands.rs:943 `"toolScope": json!([])`。5) 觸發路徑存在：proactive 建立的 session（proactive.rs:651）有 `providerSessionId`（claude 由 system/init 回填）與 `resolvedWorkdir`，到期／關閉後 AiPage 的 `!open && record.providerSessionId` 條件會顯示「接續上次（唯讀）」按鈕，通知文案只說「沿用先前的對話脈絡、原本的資料夾、時間／費用上限」，完全沒有提到工具從無變成有。

verdicts.reasoning: 逐一驗證屬實，且找到具體可達路徑：(1) crates/interaction-runtime/src/agents.rs 的 check_resume_not_wider（96-131 行，for 迴圈在 108 行）只用「請求陣列裡有、granted 陣列裡沒有」的 extra() 做子集判斷；空集合 [] 對任何 granted 陣列都通過。(2) crates/interaction-runtime/src/gateway.rs:310 `spec.disable_tools = record.tool_scope == ["conversation.generate"]` 是精確相等，不是子集/語意判斷；tool_scope=[] 時得到 disable_tools=false。(3) crates/interaction-agent-gateway/src/claude.rs:93-101，disable_tools=true → `--tools ""`（依 claude 文件會停用全部工具）；否則（含空 tool_scope）→ `--tools Read,Glob,Grep`。此 connector 完全沒有 OS 層 sandbox（全 repo 的 sandbox/chroot/seccomp 只出現在 Codex connector），--tools 是唯一閘門，所以這個切換是真實的能力落差。(4) 真實觸發鏈已驗證：crates/interaction-runtime/src/proactive.rs:651 的主動式對話 session 是全 repo唯一把 tool_scope 設成剛好 ["conversation.generate"]（disable_tools=true、零工具）的建立路徑；其 workdir 是 agent-workspaces/proactive（resolved_workdir 會回填、resume_gateway_workdir 存在性檢查會通過）。apps/interaction-desktop/src/pages/AiPage.tsx 的工作階段清單（283 行 api.agentSessionsList()、410-419 行 SessionCard）沒有依 label／tool_scope 過濾，主動式 session 一樣會被列出；655 行 `{!open && record.providerSessionId && (...)}` 對任何已結束且有 providerSessionId 的 session（含主動式）顯示「接續上次（唯讀）」按鈕，點下去呼叫 121 行 `toolScope: []` 的 buildResumeInput。CLI 路徑（crates/interaction-cli/src/commands.rs:943 `"toolScope": json!([])`）同理。check_resume_not_wider 對 tool_scope／data_scope／consent_scope 全部通過（[] 皆為子集），resume 建立成功，新 record.tool_scope=[]，gateway_attach 依 310 行判斷得到 disable_tools=false，claude 子行程從『完全零工具』變成『可 Read/Glob/Grep 讀該資料夾』。check_resume_not_wider
