confirmed.title: consent 的 maxUses 對 receptor／tool 範圍完全不生效，但 API/CLI 照收、事件與 session JSON 照樣回報 maxUses:1
confirmed.claim: `grant_consent_with_uses` 對任何 scope 都接受 `maxUses`，並把它寫進 Consent、發進 `consent.changed` 事件、記進 audit、回進 session JSON；但唯一的扣減點 `consume_one_shot_consent` 只在 executor 的動器派工路徑上跑，且只餵 Actuator／Channel 兩種 scope。因此 `receptor:microphone.listen`（或 `receptor:iphone.mic-level`、`tool:*`）帶 `--max-uses 1` 授權後，`remaining_uses` 永遠停在 1，TTL 內可無限次啟動麥克風，而 API 對外一路宣稱這是「只這一次」。CHANGELOG 把「受器與 tool-operation 仍是短效 TTL」列為較窄的已知限制，但沒有處理「介面照收並照樣回報一個後端不強制的參數」這件事——這正是誠實階梯要禁止的 claim。
confirmed.evidence: crates/interaction-runtime/src/runtime.rs:1148-1183 `grant_consent_with_uses`：只拒絕 `max_uses == Some(0)`，其餘一律 `session.grant_with_uses(scope, .., max_uses)` 並 emit `"maxUses": max_uses`、audit `{"scope":.., "maxUses":..}`。crates/interaction-core/src/session.rs:88-107 `grant_with_uses` 對所有 scope 一視同仁；:116-137 `consume_one_shot` 只在被呼叫時才扣。crates/interaction-runtime/src/executor.rs:394-408（doc comment 自承「Scope covered: actuator dispatch. Receptor consents (microphone and the other sensors) ... are NOT one-shot aware yet」）與 :676-706 建構的 `consumable` 只含 `ConsentScope::Actuator`／`ConsentScope::Channel`。感測端 crates/interaction-runtime/src/sensors.rs:130-138 `begin_mic_listen` 只做 `session.has_consent(&ConsentScope::Receptor(..))`，沒有任何消耗。CLI 端 crates/interaction-cli/src/commands.rs 的 `session consent --max-uses` 無 scope 檢查（見 commit 0c845e0 diff）。

verdicts.reasoning: Fully reproduced from source. runtime.rs:1148 grant_consent_with_uses accepts max_uses for any ConsentScope (only Some(0) rejected), stores it via Session::grant_with_uses (session.rs:88-99) unconditionally, emits EventType::ConsentChanged with "maxUses": max_uses, and audits {"scope":..,"maxUses":..} — matching evidence exactly. Repo-wide grep for consume_one_shot confirms the only non-test call site is Executor::consume_one_shot_consent (executor.rs:410), invoked once (executor.rs:708) with a `consumable` vec that is built (executor.rs ~692-704) from only ConsentScope::Actuator and ConsentScope::Channel; ConsentScope::Receptor and ConsentScope::ToolOperation never appear in any consume_one_shot call site anywhere in the runtime. Sensors::begin_mic_listen (sensors.rs:107-138) gates solely on session.has_consent(&scope, now) and never touches remaining_uses, so a Receptor consent's remaining_uses field, once set by max_uses, is never decremented — Consent::has_uses_left (policy.rs:284-286) stays true forever, letting the mic be started unboundedly many times within the TTL while the session JSON keeps reporting remainingUses:1. CLI SessionCmd::Consent (commands.rs:1267-1280) forwards max_uses verbatim to POST /v1/session/consent with zero scope validation, and the HTTP handler (routes.rs:452-460) likewise does none. This is a real, currently-present gap between what the API/CLI/events claim (a bounded, spent-on-use consent) and what is actually enforced for receptor/tool-operation scopes — directly implicating the project's honesty-ladder invariant (claims must not imply verified/enforced behavior that isn't). Mitigating factor: CHANGELOG.md (~lines 101-102, 149) already discloses '受器與tool-operation的consent仍是TTL（maxUses只計動器派工）' as a known limitation, though it doesn't spell out the specific nuance that the interface still echoes an exact maxUses/remainingUses value with no signal that it's unenforced for those scopes — which is the finding's core point and is not contradicted by the existing disclosure. No line-number drift; all cited locations match the current tree precisely.

confirmed.fix: 在 `grant_consent_with_uses` 對無法計次的 scope 明確拒絕（`Receptor`／`ToolOperation` 帶 max_uses ⇒ Validation：「這個範圍目前只支援短效 TTL，不支援單次授權」），或改成在該範圍真正實作扣減（`begin_mic_listen` 成功開窗時於同一把 session 寫鎖內 `consume_one_shot`，tool_call 於 dispatch 前扣）。在補上扣減之前，至少不要在事件／audit／session JSON 回報一個不會被強制的 maxUses。
confirmed.regressionTest: Start a session, grant `receptor:microphone.listen` with max_uses=1, call begin_mic_listen twice (or assert session.has_consent still true after simulating one logical 'use'), and assert the second call is refused / remaining_uses decremented — currently it succeeds both times and remaining_uses stays at 1.

confirmed.title: 沒有相機時無法配對：桌面從不顯示 iOS 手動配對所需的 payload JSON 與主機位址，UI 文案卻叫使用者「手動輸入電腦位址」
confirmed.claim: iOS 的手動備援只接受完整配對 JSON（`v/host/port/fp/code`），單獨輸入 6 位配對碼按鈕是 disabled 的。Runtime 已經在 `mobile_pairing_begin` 回傳現成的 `payload` 字串，但桌面 MobileSection 從不渲染它，也從不顯示 host（連進階模式也只有 port 與 fingerprint）。結果是 Bonjour 不可用又無法掃 QR（相機被占用／未授權／裝置不支援 DataScanner）時，使用者拿不到任何可貼上的內容，配對完全走不通——而同一個區塊的文案卻寫著「請掃 QR，或在手機上手動輸入電腦位址配對」。
confirmed.evidence:
CapabilitiesHub.tsx:646-651 文案：「iPhone 無法自動找到這台電腦（自動尋找未啟用…）——請掃 QR，或在手機上手動輸入電腦位址配對。」CapabilitiesHub.tsx:685 文案：「在 iPhone App 掃描 QR 或輸入配對碼」。
CapabilitiesHub.tsx:682-700 渲染的欄位只有 code / fingerprint / port / qrSvg / expiresAt——`pairing.payload` 與 host 完全沒出現（`grep -rn "payload" apps/interaction-desktop/src/pages/CapabilitiesHub.tsx` 零命中）。
Runtime 端 mobile.rs:2060-2075 確實產生並回傳 `"payload": json!({"v":1,"host":host,"port":port,"fp":fp,"code":code}).to_string()`。
iOS 端 PairingView.swift:143-157：手動區塊是 `TextEditor(text: $manualJSON)`＋`Button("開始配對"){ applyPayloadText(manualJSON) }.disabled(manualJSON…isEmpty)`；Protocol.swift `PairingPayload.parse` 的 `RawPayload` 把 `v/host/port/fp` 都宣告為必填（只有 `code` 可選）。iOS 也已經有「此裝置不支援相機文字/條碼掃描，請改用手動貼上」的分支（PairingView.swift:174-185）。

verdicts.reasoning: Verified directly against current source, not from memory. (1) apps/interaction-desktop/src/pages/CapabilitiesHub.tsx: `grep -n \"payload\"` and `grep -n \"host\"` both return zero matches in the whole file — the pairing notice box (lines 682-700) renders only code, a 6-char slice of fingerprint, port (advanced-only), qrSvg, and expiresAt. Line 649 (exact match) reads \"...請掃 QR，或在手機上手動輸入電腦位址配對\" (scan QR, or manually type the computer's address into the phone), but no computer address is ever rendered anywhere in the component. (2) crates/interaction-runtime/src/mobile.rs:2065-2079: `mobile_pairing_begin` computes `host` via `local_lan_ip()`, builds `payload = json!({\"v\":1,\"host\":host,\"port\":port,\"fp\":fp,\"code\":code})`, and returns it as `\"payload\": payload` in the response — so the data exists on the wire but the frontend never consumes it. (3) apps/interaction-ios/InteractionCompanion/Views/PairingView.swift:143-160: the manual fallback is `TextEditor(text: $manualJSON)` plus a separate `manualCode` field; the \"開始配對\" button's `.disabled(...)` gates on `manualJSON` being non-empty, not on `manualCode`. (4) Protocol.swift:168-191: `PairingPayload.parse`'s `RawPayload` requires `v`, `host`, `port`, `fp` (only `code` is optional via `codeOverride`); feeding a bare 6-digit code as `manualJSON` fails `JSONDecoder().decode(RawPayload.self,...)` → `.invalidJSON`, so the code-only path cannot succeed. (5) PairingView.swift:174-179 confirms the no-camera-support branch text exists, funneling the user into exactly this broken manual path. All cited line numbers matched exactly on live inspection (649, 685 for the two quoted UI strings; mobile.rs 2046/2065-2079). This is a genuine dead-end: with Bonjour off and camera/QR unavailable, the UI's own instructions cannot be carried out because the one piece of information needed (host, or the full payload JSON) is never surfaced, even in advanced mode.

confirmed.fix: 在配對面板加上可複製的 payload 區塊（顯示 `pairing.payload` 全文，附複製按鈕），或至少在進階模式顯示 host:port；並把文案從「手動輸入電腦位址」改成與 iOS 實際欄位一致的「手動貼上配對 JSON」。
confirmed.regressionTest: A frontend test rendering MobileSection after `mobilePairingBegin` returns a payload/host, asserting the DOM contains a copyable string equal to `pairing.payload` (or at minimum the `host` value) so a no-camera user has something to paste into the iOS manual JSON field.

refuted.title: resolveRigAnimation 對 success 的預設是 fail-open：缺 frameSlice 就演 verified 綠勾，且模組內文件化的「誠實預設 claimed」別名永遠取不到
refuted.claim: `resolveRigAnimation()` 用「有沒有 frameSlice」來區分 claimed 與 verified，而缺省（undefined）被解讀成 **verified**——也就是任何呼叫端漏傳 frameSlice，畫面就會出現綠勾＋慶祝火花＋高豎尾巴的完整成功演出。誠實階梯的預設應該是 claimed（只點頭）。更矛盾的是同一組模組裡 `EXPRESSION_ALIASES.success = "success-claimed"` 帶著註解「此處預設為誠實的 claimed」，但因為 resolveRigAnimation 在 resolveExpression 之前就攔截了 name==="success"，這個安全別名在這條路徑上永遠不會生效——實際生效的是不安全的那個預設。目前 in-tree 呼叫端（machine.pose、shuExpressionPlan）都有正確傳 slice，所以還沒有活的繞過路徑，但這是一個對外開放的 fail-open 介面（RendererBackend.setAnimation(name, frameSlice?) 的 frameSlice 是選填）。

verdicts.reasoning:
機制性事實全部核實為真：timeline.ts:173 缺 frameSlice 時確實把 wanted 解到 success-verified；EXPRESSION_ALIASES.success（expressions.ts:1473）因 resolveRigAnimation 在呼叫 resolveExpression 之前就把 "success" 改寫成 "success-claimed"/"success-verified"，該別名在這條路徑上永遠打不到，是死碼。但把這定性為「誠實階梯 fail-open 違規」站不住：

1) 真正的真相判斷不在 resolveRigAnimation，而在上一層 shuTables.ts:shuExpressionPlan 明確等式判斷：`case "verified-success": return truthState === "verified" ? plan("success","transient") : plan("success","transient",[0,1]);`——只有 truthState 明確等於 "verified" 才不給 slice；claimed／unknown／任何其他值一律落到帶 slice 的安全分支。要不要給 frameSlice 從來不是「忘了給」的意外缺省，而是上游對 truthState 做完等式檢查後才決定的正向編碼；resolveRigAnimation 只是忠實轉譯已算好的結果。
2) machine.ts:pose() 同理：`t.verified ? {animation:"success"} : {animation:"success", frameSlice:[0,1]}`，且函式上方註解明講「呼叫端已依 truthState 決定是否給 slice，這裡不做升級」——是有意的架構分工，不是疏漏。
3) rig.test.ts:132-146 明確把「success 無 slice → success-verified（綠勾）」斷言為期望行為，是已被測試覆蓋、視為正確的既有防護。
4) resolveRigAnimation 是模組內部純函式，唯一呼叫端是同一封閉可信 codebase 內、已驗證安全的三處（machine.ts pose、shuTables.ts plan、內部 renderer/stage）；CPP 的外部邊界是 WebSocket 協定（crates/interaction-character），與這支 TS 函式無關，所以「對外開放的 fail-open 介面」的定性不準確。finding 自己也承認「目前 in-tree 呼叫端都有正確傳 slice，還沒有活的繞過路徑」。EXPRESSION_ALIASES.success 死碼＋註解過時是唯一站得住的殘留觀察，但用 isShuPlayable 交叉檢查：即使該別名被觸發，success-claimed 與 success-verified 的 truthState 都是 true，行為結果一致，連這個死碼都沒有可觀察副作用——純屬文件/命名層面小瑕疵，不構成功能缺陷，不違反誠實階梯不變量。

refuted.fix: 把預設翻成誠實那一側：改為只有明確的 verified 訊號（例如新增 `verified?: boolean` 參數或要求 `frameSlice === undefined && verified === true`）才解析到 success-verified，缺省一律 success-claimed；或直接讓 name==="success" 走 EXPRESSION_ALIASES（claimed），verified 由呼叫端明寫 "success-verified"。

refuted.title: 緊急停止時桌面角色把感測指示整條隱藏，正好蓋掉「可能仍在擷取」的情況
refuted.file: apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/CompanionApp.tsx:2004（程式碼事實無誤，但不構成不變量違反——見 reasoning）
refuted.claim: companion 視窗用 `{!estop && sensorLabel && …}` 把感測標籤與緊急停止標籤做成互斥。但 runtime 在緊急停止後**刻意**保留「已要求停止、手機未確認」的手機感測（state `stop-unknown`），因為未知≠已停；也就是說「estop 中且手機可能還在錄音」是一個真實可達的狀態，而這正是角色視窗把感測指示藏起來的那一刻。感測不靜默的不變量在這個 surface 上被 estop 條件破壞。
refuted.evidence:
CompanionApp.tsx:1999-2009: ``` {estop && (
緊急停止中
)} {!estop && sensorLabel && (
{sensorLabel}
)} ``` Runtime 端證據： - crates/interaction-runtime/src/runtime.rs:955-968 emergency_stop 只做**有界等待**，`uncertain = devices.iter().any(|d| d.outcome != Stopped)`。 - crates/interaction-runtime/src/mobile.rs:2425-2439：`Some(_) => (SENSOR_STATE_STOP_UNKNOWN, "iPhone 麥克風音量：停止結果未知（iPhone 未回覆，可能仍在擷取）")`，且 `if !enabled && state == SENSOR_STATE_ACTIVE { return None; }` —— 明寫非 active 狀態即使受器已停用也**不得**從 activeSensors 消失。 對照：控制中心同時渲染 estop banner 與 SensorBanner（App.tsx:562-576，兩者無互斥條件），可信 host overlay 也同時輸出 estop 與 mic 兩行（src/overlay/hostSafety.ts:87-101）。只有角色視窗二選一。

verdicts.reasoning:
程式碼事實本身無誤：CompanionApp.tsx:2004 確實是 `{!estop && sensorLabel && …}`，estop 時角色視窗自己的感測小字（sensorLabel／companion-sensor-label）會被蓋掉，而 runtime 端（runtime.rs:955-968、mobile.rs:2412-2439）也確實會在 emergency_stop 之後把 `iphone.mic-level` 留在 `SENSOR_STATE_STOP_UNKNOWN`（「停止結果未知，可能仍在擷取」），這個 estop=true ∧ 手機未知仍在錄音的組合是真實可達狀態。

但這不構成對「感測不靜默」不變量的違反，因為這個系統把安全訊息的權威通道明確放在別處，且該通道已經、確實同時顯示兩者：

1. 專案有一個獨立於角色 renderer 的「可信 host overlay」視窗（`apps/interaction-desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs:2733` 起 `OVERLAY_LABEL`／`create_overlay_window`／`sync_overlay_window`；前端 `src/overlay/OverlayApp.tsx`＋`src/overlay/hostSafety.ts`）。程式碼註解直接點名這就是為了 CPP README §9「隱藏感測指示／改寫安全固定文字」這一列而做的：「內容只來自 Rust 的 host-safety 事件…視窗由 Rust 建立為 click-through、置頂、不取焦點」，且**與 companion 視窗顯示與否無關**（`sync_overlay_window` 只依 `view.active` 決定開關，不看 `companion_visible`）。
2. `host_safety.rs::HostSafetyView::derive` 與 TS 端 `deriveOverlayLines` 對 estop 與感測列完全不互斥：estop 行與 mic 行各自獨立 push（hostSafety.ts:87-101 我已讀過，deriveOverlayLines 先 push estop 再 push mic，兩者條件無交集）。`sensor_text()`／`SensorView.state` 明確保留 `stop-unknown`，且 `host_safety.rs:151-171` 的 `sensor_text()` 會在文字裡加上「停止結果未知（來源未回覆）」；對應單元測試 `a_sensor_being_stopped_is_never_hidden_and_says_so`（host_safety.rs:238-268）直接驗證 stop-unknown 感測「一定不能消失」且文字要說出「結果未知」，另一測試 `estop_shows_even_with_nothing_else` 驗證 estop 獨立顯示。兩者邏輯上沒有互斥條件，estop=true 時 mic-uncertain 一樣會出現在 overlay。
3. 更新即時性：`host_safety_relevant`（lib.rs:2828-2839）把 `EmergencyStop`／`SensorStopUncertain` 都列為需要立即刷新 tray／overlay 的事件（有測試 lib.rs:3966-3974 覆蓋），不是等 4 秒輪詢。
4. 這也正是 CLAUDE.md 本身寫死的不變量文字：「安全訊息永遠落到 `system.text`＋可信 host overlay」——不是要求角色視窗自己的每一個裝飾性狀態列都要覆蓋所有安全語意，而是明確把權威通道放在 system.text／trustedText（CompanionApp.tsx 裡確有獨立於 sensorLabel 的 `trustedText` 元素，adapter 碰不到）與這個獨立可信 overlay 視窗。

finding 自己的「對照」段落其實已經引用了 `hostSafety.ts:87-101` 這個雙行機制，卻把它解讀成「只有角色視窗二選一」是一個需要修的缺口——但角色視窗（companion-sensor-label）本來就不是這個不變量的權威呈現面；它是可被 adapter／角色包影響的展示層小字，而系統刻意在它旁邊（同一台桌機、同時彈出、estop 觸發即時刷新）疊了一個 adapter 完全碰不到的可信視窗，兩者同時存在時，使用者不會只看到「緊急停止中」而看不到「麥克風可能仍在擷取」的警示。因此判定：not-a-bug（防護已由另一個經測試、文件化、即時刷新的可信通道覆蓋，符合「已被測試覆蓋的防護」的 refute 準則），而非 v0.5 的真實安全缺陷。

refuted.fix: 移除 `!estop &&`，讓 estop 標籤與感測標籤並存（必要時改成上下兩行或合併成一列），與 overlay／控制中心一致。

refuted.title: MQTT 在 subscribe 之前就把連線標成 Connected，且 subscribe 失敗被靜默吞掉、永不重試
refuted.claim: eventloop 的 ConnAck 分支先 `generation+1`／`connected=true`／`state=CONNECTED`，才去 subscribe `<prefix>/from-device`，而且 subscribe 的 Result 被 `let _ =` 丟掉。一旦這次 subscribe 失敗（request channel 已關閉／已滿），這條 link 在整個連線世代裡再也收不到裝置任何訊息，卻持續以 `connected()==true`、`link_state()==Connected` 對外回報，而且沒有任何 warn、audit 或重試路徑——只有在下一次 broker 斷線重連時才可能重新訂閱。這與 RawLink::connected 的契約註解（「健康度不得硬編 healthy：實作必須真的知道」）和「感測不靜默」的方向相反：主機端明明知道自己沒訂閱成功，卻不說。
refuted.evidence: mqtt.rs:147-155：`Ok(Event::Incoming(Packet::ConnAck(_))) => { backoff = BACKOFF_START_MS; generation.fetch_add(1, ..); connected.store(true, ..); state.store(STATE_CONNECTED, ..); let _ = client_of(&client_slot).subscribe(&topic_from, QoS::AtLeastOnce).await; }`。整個檔案裡再無第二處 subscribe（`grep -n subscribe mqtt.rs` 只有這一處與 RawLink::subscribe 的 broadcast 訂閱），因此失敗即永久失聯。另注意 rumqttc 0.24 的 `AsyncClient::subscribe` 是 `self.request_tx.send_async(request).await`（~/.cargo/.../rumqttc-0.24.0/src/client.rs:152-157），其唯一消費者就是此刻沒有在跑的 `eventloop.poll()`，所以在 request channel（REQUEST_CHANNEL_CAP=16）滿的極端情況下這個 await 還會把 eventloop task 卡死。

verdicts.reasoning:
The literal micro-facts in the finding are accurate: mqtt.rs:147-155 does set `generation+1`/`connected=true`/`state=STATE_CONNECTED` before awaiting `subscribe()`, and the subscribe `Result` is discarded via `let _ =` with no `tracing::warn!`/retry (grep confirms this is the only `subscribe` call in the file besides the internal broadcast subscribe). No line drift.

But the finding's central claim — that this leaves the system "持續以 connected()==true、link_state()==Connected 對外回報" a healthy link that silently swallows the failure, violating 感測不靜默 — does not survive tracing how these raw signals are actually consumed:

1. `RawLink::connected()`/`link_state()` are internal-only signals. `grep` shows the only external consumers are `DeviceLink::readiness()` (protocol.rs:415-434) and link_caps.rs's health mapping (line 136-152) — nothing surfaces raw `connected()` directly to CLI/API/UI.

2. `readiness()` does NOT return `Ready` just because `link_state()==Connected`. For the `Connected` case it first checks `ready_generation` against `ready_marker(generation)` and returns `LinkReadiness::NotHandshaken` unless the hello/pair handshake has actually completed (protocol.rs:420-425). `link_caps.rs:143` maps `NotHandshaken` to `ComponentHealth::degraded(...)`, not healthy.

3. The handshake (`ensure_ready_generation`, protocol.rs:493-520) subscribes to the broadcast channel, publishes `Who`, and `wait_for`s a `Hello` with a hard `HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT = 2.5s` (protocol.rs:379), mapping a timeout to a `LinkError` via `handshake_wait_error` (protocol.rs:517, 1205). If the MQTT-layer `subscribe()` to `from-device` truly never took effect, the device's `hello` can never arrive, so *every* handshake attempt honestly times out and returns an explicit error — it never silently reports success.

So in the scenario the finding worries about, the system does not stay silent: any caller trying to use the link gets an explicit 2.5s-bounded `LinkError`, and the health endpoint (`link_caps.rs`) reports `degraded`/`NotHandshaken`, not connected/healthy. This is exactly the 感測不靜默 / honesty-ladder behavior the invariant asks for, just implemented one layer up (handshake + readiness) rather than at the raw subscribe call.

Separately, the finding's specific failure trigger ("request channel 已關閉／已滿") doesn't hold up mechanically either: `AsyncClient::subscribe` calls `flume::Sender::send_async`, which only returns `Err` if the receiver (`EventLoop.requests_rx`) has been dropped — and within this task's control flow the `eventloop` object that just produced the ConnAck is exactly the one whose receiver is live and not replaced until a later `Err(e)` branch, so subscribe erroring here is effectively unreachable in the current code. A full (16-cap) channel would make `send_async` await for room rather than return an `Err` to discard — a real but different problem (a potential eventloop-task stall) than "the Err is silently swallowed."

Net effect: the code-order/`let _ =` observation is real as a micro code-quality nit, but the finding's claimed consequence (permanently false-healthy, invariant-violating silence with zero recourse) is refuted by the actual layered design (handshake timeout + `readiness()`/`link_caps` degrade path), so I'm marking this not confirmed.

refuted.fix: 改成先 subscribe 成功再 `connected=true`／`state=CONNECTED`；把 Result 取出，失敗時 `tracing::warn!` ＋把 state 標成 DISCONNECTED 並走退避重連（而不是留在 Connected）。若要避免在 eventloop task 內 await 請求佇列，改用 `try_subscribe` 並在失敗時直接判定這一代連線不可用。

refuted.title: cancel 把裝置的「我丟掉了這則訊息」(err busy) 與 err not-paired 一律翻成「裝置回報沒有可取消的效果」
refuted.claim: LinkActuator::cancel 只有 `Ack{cancelled:Some(true)}` 走成功路徑，其餘**所有** Ok 回覆（包含裝置明確送出的 `err`）都落進 `Ok(_) => NotFound("device reports no cancellable effect")`。裝置說的是「這則 cancel 被丟棄／被拒絕、從未執行」，host 卻對呼叫端（與 AI）給出一個關於**效果狀態**的確定否定結論——此時 vibe／buzzer 仍在跑。這是誠實階梯的反向違規：unknown/refused 被演成確定的 negative，且發生在安全路徑（cancel）上。
refuted.evidence: link_caps.rs:402-414：`match self.link.cancel(...).await { Ok(DeviceMsg::Ack{cancelled:Some(true),..}) => Ok(...), Ok(_) => Err(ActuatorError::NotFound(format!("{action_id}: device reports no cancellable effect"))), Err(e) => Err(ActuatorError::Unavailable(...)) }`。protocol.rs:832-861 的 cancel() 會把 `Err{id:Some(id)}` 與（in_flight<=1 時）`Err{id:None}` 當成本次請求的回覆並以 Ok 回傳，所以 err 走的是 `Ok(_)` 這一支。可達的裝置端來源：(a) BLE 入站佇列滿 → esp32-companion.ino:991 `g_bleDropBusy = true;`、:1002 `sendErr(LINK_BLE, nullptr, "busy");`，README 第 482-490 行明寫「佇列滿 → err busy（**訊息被丟棄，沒有被排隊也沒有被執行**）」——此時 vibe.pulse（≤3000ms）／buzzer.beep（≤2000ms）仍在裝置上運行；(b) esp32-companion.ino:798-800 `sendErr(link, id[0] ? id : nullptr, "not-paired")`（裝置端配對狀態被重置後）。兩者 host 都會報成「沒有可取消的效果」。

verdicts.reasoning:
The low-level code claim is accurate: LinkActuator::cancel's Ok(_) arm (still at link_caps.rs:412) does fold ANY non-Ack Ok reply — including an explicit device err{reason:"busy"} or err{reason:"not-paired"} — into Err(ActuatorError::NotFound("{action_id}: device reports no cancellable effect")). I verified both cited firmware sources are real and reachable: esp32-companion.ino:990-991/1001-1002 (bounded BLE queue full → message dropped unparsed, sendErr(LINK_BLE, nullptr, "busy")) and esp32-companion.ino:798-800 (cmd/read/cancel while unauthorized → sendErr(link, id, "not-paired")), matching README.md:488-490's "queue full → err busy, message dropped, never queued or executed". protocol.rs's cancel() (805-868) returns these as Ok(DeviceMsg::Err{..}) via wait_reply's id-matching (830-831) and the in_flight<=1 id-less-error attribution (836-845), so they do land in link_caps.rs's Ok(_) catch-all exactly as described.

However the finding's central impact claim — that host gives the caller/AI "a definite negative conclusion about effect state," an honesty-ladder violation — does not hold once you trace the only caller of this trait method. interaction-runtime/src/runtime.rs::cancel_action (850-909) calls actuator.cancel(action_id) and, per its own comment at 858-862 explicitly naming this exact concern, treats EVERY Err from the driver — regardless of ActuatorError variant (NotFound is not special-cased anywhere) — identically as "unconfirmed": Ok(Err(e)) => Some(format!("driver did not confirm the cancel: {e}")) (872), forcing terminal = ActionStatus::Uncertain, verification.verdict = VerificationVerdict::Uncertain, and emitting EventType::ActionUncertain (never ActionCancelled). Both HTTP cancel routes (interaction-api/src/routes.rs:406, :727) and the CLI (interaction-cli/src/commands.rs:1212 -> POST /v1/actions/{id}/cancel) go exclusively through this same cancel_action — there is no other path from LinkActuator::cancel to a caller or to the AI. So the busy/not-paired case does NOT reach the AI as a confirmed "no effect" claim; it reaches it as Uncertain, which is precisely what the project's honesty-ladder invariant requires.

What remains real but minor: the embedded diagnostic text "device reports no cancellable effect" (nested inside the NotFound variant whose Display is "action {0} not found", rendering as a slightly garbled "...device reports no cancellable effect not found") conflates "no such tracked action" with "device explicitly refused/dropped this cancel while the effect may still be running." That's a legitimate small clarity issue in an audit-log/receipt error-detail string, but it is not the high-severity honesty-ladder violation described, since the authoritative status/verdict actually surfaced to the API/CLI/AI is correctly Uncertain, not a confirmed negative.

The link_caps.rs-level conflation is real (Ok(_) at line 411-413 does collapse err-busy, err-not-paired, and any other non-`cancelled:true` Ack into one `NotFound("device reports no cancellable effect")`), but the finding stops its trace one layer too early. The only production call site for `Actuator::cancel` is `Runtime::cancel_action` (crates/interaction-runtime/src/runtime.rs:850-919), and it does NOT propagate that error text as a confident claim about effect state. Its match arm is generic over *any* `Err` from the driver:

```
Ok(Err(e)) => Some(format!("driver did not confirm the cancel: {e}")),
```

Any such error — NotFound, Unavailable, whatever — sets `unconfirmed = Some(..)`, which forces `ActionStatus::Uncertain`, `VerificationVerdict::Uncertain`, a `cancel_unconfirmed` receipt error, an `ActionUncertain` event, and an audit entry with `"outcome":"uncertain"`. The code comment directly above this match (runtime.rs:855-859) states exactly the invariant the finding invokes ("回錯／逾時／動器不在了 ⇒ 我們不知道那個外部效果有沒有停下來，必須是 Uncertain"), and it is enforced uniformly regardless of which ActuatorError variant came back — there is no branch that treats `NotFound` as a confirmed negative.

This is independently verified by an existing test, `cancel_action_is_uncertain_when_the_driver_does_not_confirm` (crates/interaction-runtime/tests/runtime_loop.rs:1618-1636), whose comment reads "driver 回錯 ⇒ 結果未知，不得謊稱已取消" and which asserts `ActionStatus::Uncertain` plus a `cancel_unconfirmed` error code for exactly a driver-returns-Err scenario. The CLI (`interact-ai cancel`, commands.rs:1209-1213) and the HTTP route (routes.rs:406) both surface this same receipt verbatim — status `uncertain`, not a "no effect to cancel" negative.

So the actual object visible to the caller/AI after a busy-drop or not-paired cancel is `status: Uncertain` with a (verbosely worded, admittedly confusing) detail string, not a confident "nothing was running" claim. That is precisely the honesty-ladder behavior CLAUDE.md requires (result unknown → uncertain), not a violation of it. The link_caps.rs internal Result type merging err-busy/err-not-paired/genuine-already-done into one Rust enum variant is an internal wart (the message text is misleading and could be tightened, e.g. by matching on `DeviceMsg::Err{reason,..}` and mapping busy/not-paired to `Unavailable` for a clearer detail string) — but it does not reach the AI or human operator as a false definitive negative, because the sole caller already coerces every driver-side cancel failure into `Uncertain` before it leaves the runtime. I therefore cannot substantiate "high severity, confirmed violation of the honesty ladder on a safety path" — the safety net the finding says is missing is present one layer up and is test-covered.

refuted.fix: 在 match 中把 `Ok(DeviceMsg::Err{reason,..})` 獨立出來：只有 `reason == "not-found"` 才是 NotFound；其餘（busy／not-paired／bad-params…）回 `ActuatorError::Unavailable(format!("device refused the cancel: {reason} — effect state UNKNOWN"))`，與 Err(e) 分支同語氣。順手把 `Ok(other)` 也改成 Unavailable（未預期回覆＝未知，不是確定沒有效果）。

refuted.title: CHANGELOG [Unreleased] 有一條完全重複的條目（同一段文字出現兩次）
refuted.claim: 「工作資料夾不得位於 runtime `state/` 底下」這條在 [Unreleased] 的同一個 `#### Fixed — 一般模式與誠實狀態` 區塊裡出現兩次，內容逐字相同，會讓讀者以為是兩個不同的修復。
refuted.evidence: `grep -n "工作資料夾不得位於" CHANGELOG.md` → 71 與 105 兩個命中；兩處內文皆為「`resolve_gateway_workdir` 的檢查改為雙向；runtime 自己的主動式對話工作區搬到 `agent-workspaces/proactive`。」（:71 只是少了 `state/` 的反引號）。對應的實作只有一個 commit（`80fe2c8 fix(agents): refuse workdirs inside the runtime state directory`）。

verdicts.reasoning: 親自對 <repo>/CHANGELOG.md 執行 `grep -n "工作資料夾不得位於"`，目前只有一個命中（第 72 行），不是 finding 所稱的 71 與 105 兩處。查看第 105 行實際內容，是完全不相關的「`cancel_action` 誠實化」條目的一部分，與「工作資料夾不得位於 runtime state/ 底下」毫無關係。進一步用 `git log -p -3 -- CHANGELOG.md` 檢查最近三次觸及此檔的 commit（12bc81e／521c232／d03e0b9），該關鍵字在這些歷史版本中同樣只出現一次，找不到曾經重複過的證據。對應實作只有一個 commit（`80fe2c8`），也支持只有一次修復、一個 changelog 條目的結論。此 finding 描述的「同一段文字出現兩次」在目前檔案內容與可查的近期歷史中都不成立。

refuted.fix: 刪掉 CHANGELOG.md:105-106 的重複條目，保留 :71-72 那一條即可。
